We push hard, learn quickly and stay human along the way. It’s this wonderful mix of high performance and real community that makes Delivery Hero a place where ambition and belonging grow side by side. If you’re curious, collaborative and ready to dive deep into meaningful work, you’ll fit right in.

Job Description

- Lead and grow the team. You manage a team of Product Operations Specialists and are accountable for the results and impact of their work – setting priorities, coaching them into owners of their own market and product portfolios, and building the bench for the next layer of ownership.
- Set direction for the function. You contribute to the supply chain strategy and priorities for Dmarts, own multiple key results end to end, and align on shared strategic goals with central and regional leadership.
- Lead the Supply Chain target setting process. Set availability, fill rate, days on hand and spoilage targets per market, negotiate them with regional leadership, and hold the business accountable to them.
- Own the central demand planning framework across 40+ countries and develop the standards and guardrails markets plan against
- Drive the regular business planning alongside commercial and supplier management teams, establish the long-term capacity plan, and track forecast accuracy to translate our growth ambition into concrete network, inventory and supplier requirements.
- Achieve outcomes through others. The majority of your time goes to stakeholder management – aligning senior regional supply chain, store operations and commercial leaders, resolving misalignment before it escalates, and moving markets without formal authority over them.
- Influence product strategy and roadmaps. You are the business voice in the central product team: preparing business cases, aggregating and challenging feature requests from markets, and protecting roadmap focus by resolving what doesn't need engineering.
- Own rollouts and adoption end to end – pilot design, market readiness, training and hypercare – and be accountable for how well countries actually use our products, measured on adoption depth rather than deployment count.
- Own the market support model. The intake, triage and escalation path your team runs on features, bugs and questions, pulling in your product counterparts only where genuinely required.
- Be the supply chain subject-matter expert in the central team – the person regional teams consult when a problem has no obvious owner – and define the SOPs and streamline processes that turn what works in one market into a standard for the rest.
- Own business reporting and impact measurement. Standard KPI reporting, ad-hoc analysis and post-launch measurement of what our products moved, delivered through your team.

Qualifications

- 7+ years in supply chain planning or operations, ideally in Quick Commerce, grocery retail or FMCG – fast-paced, high-volume, imperfect data.
- People management experience. You have led specialists or analysts, delegate real ownership rather than tasks, give direct feedback, and take accountability for your team's results as your own.

- A track record with product and tech teams – writing requirements, building business cases, running multi-market rollouts, and driving adoption after go-live.
- Product and data fluency. You know our tools well enough to spot where they break the business, you can interrogate data yourself (SQL/BigQuery, advanced Sheets, Looker/Tableau), and you set the standard for how your team analyses and visualises – you don't need to build every dashboard, but you know when one is wrong.
- Process standardisation across markets – SOPs, playbooks and governance that survive after you leave the room.

Die INSBI bietet betreutes Wohnen für unbegleitete minderjährige Flüchtlinge (UmF) ab 16 Jahren und für junge Volljährige an. Unser Ziel ist es, diesen Menschen einen sicheren und stabilen Lebensraum zu bieten, in dem sie Vertrauen, Orientierung und Perspektiven für ihre Zukunft entwickeln können.

In Zusammenarbeit mit Jugendämtern und Bildungsträgern setzen wir uns für die gesellschaftliche und berufliche Integration junger Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen ein. Unsere Arbeit basiert auf einem ressourcenorientierten Ansatz und folgt dem Prinzip des Empowerments: Wir begleiten die Jugendlichen individuell und stärken sie in ihrer persönlichen und beruflichen Entwicklung.

Besonders für junge Flüchtlinge, die oft traumatische Erlebnisse hinter sich haben, ist eine stabile und vertrauensvolle Beziehung essenziell. Durch unser Bezugsbetreuersystem bieten wir Halt, Orientierung und fördern ihre Selbstständigkeit.

Mit unserer langjährigen Erfahrung in der Jugendhilfe und Flüchtlingshilfe gestalten wir ein Umfeld, das Sicherheit, Schutz und eine realistische Zukunftsperspektive ermöglicht. Dabei legen wir Wert auf interkulturelle Sensibilität, Reflexion und eine enge Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen Akteuren, um den Jugendlichen bestmögliche Chancen zu bieten.

Darum geht's - Ihre Aufgaben
Als pädagogische/r Mitarbeiter/in in der ambulanten Betreuung im Betreuten Wohnen für minderjährige und junge volljährige Flüchtlinge übernehmen Sie unter anderem folgende Aufgaben:

- Anleitung und Unterstützung der jungen Menschen im lebenspraktischen Bereich, im Besonderen der Verselbstständigung in einer eigenen Wohnung oder WG.
- Begleitung und Unterstützung bei der Abklärung asyl- und aufenthaltsrechtlicher Fragen und der Sicherstellung des Lebensunterhalts
- Einzelförderung im schulischen, beruflichen, sozial-emotionalen und gesundheitlichen Bereich sowie Freizeitgestaltung
- Krisenintervention
- Zusammenarbeit mit Jugendämtern, Behörden, Rechtsanwältinnen, Schulen, Ausbilderinnen und Ärzt*innen

title: Head Operational Excellence Europe (m/f/d) (Operations Manager/in)
description:
To further strengthen our Operations & Supply Chain organization, we are looking for an experienced Head of Operational Excellence at Group level.

This high-impact role, reporting directly to the COO, offers a unique opportunity to design, build, and implement the Operational Excellence system from the start. You will operate within an international environment with multiple manufacturing sites.

In this initial phase, you will take the lead in developing and rolling out the foundation of our Operational Excellence framework, driving sustainable operational improvements throughout the organization.

Your mission

- In the first phase, your key responsibility will be to: - Design and establish the Group-wide Operational Excellence Production System
- Build the standards, tools and governance needed for sustainable implementation
- Create and roll out structured processes across Production, Logistics and Quality
- Set up performance management (KPI cascade, visual management, gap analysis)
- Develop and initiate the first wave of improvement projects and cost optimization pipeline
- Following this setup phase, you will: - Drive year-on-year efficiency improvements
- Scale and embed Lean & Six Sigma methodologies across all sites
- Act as a change leader, embedding mindset, behavior and capabilities

Your profile

- Master’s degree in engineering with strong analytical and statistical skills
- At least 3 years of leadership experience in a complex operations/manufacturing environment
- Strong track record in building and implementing Operational Excellence frameworks from the ground up
- Deep expertise in Lean / Six Sigma (Green/Black Belt preferred)
- Structured, hands-on and capable of turning concepts into execution
- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
- Willingness to travel across Europe (25–50%)
- Fluent in English and preferably German

Benefits

- **Work-life balance:** We offer flexible working hours in a hybrid work environment
- **Time off & flexibility:** With 30 days of vacation per year and flexible scheduling
- **Quick decision-making & autonomy:** You’ll benefit from quick decision-making and plenty of freedom to pursue your own ideas and creative solutions
- **Motivated team & international environment:** Work in a dedicated team with colleagues from different countries and cultures
- Individual management coaching: We support your personal and professional development through individual coaching
- **Exciting tasks:** Look forward to varied responsibilities in a sustainable and innovative company
- **Comprehensive benefits:** Enjoy advantages such as capital-forming benefits, TicketPlus, Hansefit and exclusive discounts

Your next step - get in touch!

We welcome your application, including details of your salary expectations and your earliest possible start date. For initial contact, please reach out to Roman Heizmann, Recruiting Manager.

title: Swedish Speaking Automotive Warranty Assistant (Opel/Vauxhall)
description:
Swedish Speaking Automotive Warranty Assistant (Opel/Vauxhall)
Location: Budaörs, Budapest, Hungary

Concentrix, a global leader in Customer Service, work in partnership with the prestigious Opel/Vauxhall brand across Europe. We are currently recruiting for Warranty Assistants to join our team in Budaörs, Hungary. Located in state of the art facilities, our team of multilingual experts support a range of languages and assist the Opel/Vauxhall dealer network with the diagnosis and repair of vehicles.

What you can expect day to day:
. Handle warranty claims via phone and email.
. Fully investigating the request using Opel/Vauxhall systems, protocol and procedures.
. Escalating requests that cannot be resolved to other team members, and team leaders located both in the UK and Germany.
. Delivering service excellence by efficiently problem-solving and reacting in a professional, polite and clear manner.
. Accurately logging all Dealer contacts and following up on cases using Opel/Vauxhall database systems.
. Attending team and other meetings for review of issues, assignments, regular discussion.

What we're looking for:
. Automotive knowledge and experience preferred, gained either in a dealership, preferably Opel/Vauxhall, or with an OEM or OEM supplier business.
. Fluency in English & Swedish.
. Previous experience of handling warranty claims preferred.
. Excellent interpersonal skills, able to build constructive & effective relationships, using appropriate rapport,     diplomacy and tact.
. Ability to resolve queries to a high level remotely by telephone/email.
. Opel/Vauxhall product experience preferable.
. Good computer literacy - competent in the main Microsoft Office packages.
. Able to write clearly and succinctly in a variety of communication settings and styles.
. Time management skills, able to use time effectively and efficiently.
. Customer focus, dedicated to meeting the expectations and requirements of internal & external customers.

What can we offer you?
. Bright, modern, exciting place to work with excellent staff facilities
. Multicultural, multilingual environment.
. Excellent relocation package.
. Annual Reward & Recognition Ceremony.
. Professional development opportunities.

Relocating to Budaörs?

title: Erä- ja luonto opas tai muu luontomatkailualan ammattilainen
description:
**Etsin lisää luontomatkailualan ammattilaisia yhteistyöhön kanssani ja osaksi yritykseni Wild Adventures North kasvutarinaa.**

Wild Adventures North on erikoistunut järjestämään villejä seikkailuja suomalaiselle kohderyhmälle. Tarjoamme 10 vuoden kokemuksella autenttisen eräkokemuksen sen kaikessa karuudessaan ja kauneudessaan.

Elämyksiä suunnittelee ja toteuttaa yhteistyössä alan ammattilaisista koostuva tiimi. Toiminta-alueemme kattaa Suomen, Ruotsin ja Norjan upeimmat luontokohteet.

Meille luonnossa liikkuminen on enemmän kuin siirtymistä paikasta toiseen - se on oppimista oivaltamista a yhteyttä ympäröivään luontoon, Opetamme asiakkaalle kaiken, mitä hän tarvitsee - ja vähän enemmänkin.

Tarjontamme on omassa kategoriassaan Suomen laajin: valikoimaamme kuuluu jo 69 erilaista patikka- hiihto-, melonta-, juoksu-, lumikenkä- ja jäätikkövaellusta sekä selviytymiskoulutusta. Meidän kanssamme asiakas voi esimerkiksi:

- vaeltaa koko Suomen Lapin halki kaikkien 12 erämaan läpi

- nousta Suomen korkeimmalle tunturille - ja huiputtaa pikavaellustyylillä kaikki Suomen 33 yli 1000-metristä tunturia

- saavuttaa Suomen ja Ruotsin erämaisimmat pisteet meloa packraftilla niin sileässä vedessä kuin kuohuvissa koskissakin suorittaa Suomen vaativimman kaupallisen selviytymiskokeen, jossa hänet eksytetään helikopterilla viikoksi erämaahan ilman ruokaa, telttaa ja makuupussia - ja käydä ensin siihen valmistavan koulutuspolun

- vaeltaa Pohjois-Norjan jäätikköerämaassa köysistössä, jääraudat jalassa ja hakku kädessä


Yritykseni lähivuosien tavoitteena on laajentaa;

- toiminta uusiin maihin

- markkinointi suomalaisille yrityksille ja lapsiperheille

- elämystarjonta uusiin lajeihin


Jos sinulla on kompetenssia ja ideaa tarttua johonkin näistä kolmesta tavoitteesta, saatat olla etsimäni ammattilainen.

Yhteistyö kanssani tarkoittaa sitä, että olemme yhdessä laatineet välillemme yhteistyösopimuksen, joka mm. määrittelee roolit, tehtävät, vastuun ja potin iaon. Olet yrittäjä, joka laskuttaa yritystäni palveluistaan.

Yhteistyössä kanssani on eri tasoja. Voit olla vieraileva opas, joka tekee yhden tai useamman yksittäisen keikan. Tai voit olla kiinteä osa brändini suojeluksessa toimivaa opastiimiä, joka suunnittelee, testaa ja toteuttaa uusia elämyksiä

Yhteistyö kanssani on kannattavaa, jos et halua rakentaa uutta luontomatkailubisnestä tyhjästä. Pääset hyötymään yritykseni 10 vuoden ajan rakennetusta laajasta asiakaspoolista, näkyvyydestä, vakiintuneesta markkina-asemasta, ryhmäkalustosta ja tiimin vertaistuesta.

Odotan yhteydenottoasi!

title: Prentari / Printer
description:
Prentmet Oddi leitar að ábyrgðarmiklum, nákvæmum og metnaðarfullum starfsmanni til að sinna starfi prentara.
Um er að ræða fjölbreytt og krefjandi starf í öflugu framleiðsluumhverfi þar sem gæði, þjónusta og fagmennska eru í fyrirrúmi.

Helstu verkefni:
Stýra og hafa umsjón með offsetprentvél.
Úttekt og samanburður prófarka og prentarka til að tryggja gæði framleiðslu.
Umsjón með viðhaldi véla og útfylling viðhaldsbókar.

title: Technical Director

CCP Games is seeking a Technical Director to lead the technical direction of Core Technology and CARBON — CCP's shared game development platform spanning engine runtime, rendering, graphics, tools, pipelines, and developer experience.

In this role, you will set the technical direction for CARBON, ensuring it evolves as a high-leverage, modern platform that creates meaningful value for game teams across CCP. Reporting to the Senior Development Director of Core Technology, you will translate product vision and organizational priorities into clear technical direction and execution. You will directly manage technical leaders across Graphics, Runtime, and Tools, maintaining visibility into the health and opportunities across the department while keeping teams aligned on a coherent engineering direction.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will contribute through architecture, technical guidance, and code review, while focusing primarily on raising the effectiveness and goals of the engineers and leaders around you.

The position is located in Reykjavík, Iceland.

Your Tasks:

Define and drive the technical direction for CARBON across runtime, graphics, rendering, tools, pipelines, and shared developer technology.

Collaborate closely with the Senior Development Director of Core Technology to translate product vision and priorities into clear technical strategy and execution.

Lead and develop technical leaders across Graphics, Runtime, and Tools, strengthening quality, alignment, and team growth.

Provide architectural guidance across CARBON, ensuring great decisions around performance, scalability, maintainability, and developer experience.

Guide the department in adopting AI-assisted development in practical, high-value ways that improve speed, iteration, and engineering effectiveness.

Shape CARBON's open-source direction to increase platform leverage, accessibility, and long-term relevance.

Communicate technical direction, tradeoffs, risks, and opportunities across the organization.





Your Profile:

Significant senior technical leadership experience in game development.

Deep game engine expertise across runtime systems, rendering or graphics, and developer tooling.

Proven ability to define technical direction and align multiple teams around a coherent engineering vision.

People leadership experience across senior engineers, technical leads, or engineering managers.

Conviction in the value of AI-assisted and open-source development, with the judgment to apply both strategically and practically.

A pragmatic, growth-oriented leadership style with a bias toward learning, experimentation, and solution-finding within real-world constraints.

Experienced enough as an engineer to lead with credibility through technical judgment, architecture, and code review.

Excellent communication skills, able to convey complex technical topics clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Record relevant machine settings, process parameters, technical interventions and production information. Assist engineering and technical personnel with machine modifications and continuous-improvement projects. Support initiatives aimed at reducing machine downtime, manufacturing waste and production defects. Work closely with engineering, maintenance, quality and production personnel to maintain safe and efficient manufacturing operations. Comply with company quality, food-safety, environmental and health-and-safety procedures. Undertake technical training in thermoforming machinery, manufacturing processes and associated equipment. Requirements: A qualification in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Manufacturing Engineering, Automation Engineering or another relevant technical/engineering discipline. Good mechanical and technical aptitude. Ability to understand and interpret technical drawings and equipment documentation. Understanding of mechanical systems and manufacturing equipment. Good problem-solving and analytical skills. Ability to work effectively as part of an engineering and manufacturing team. Good communication and organisational skills.

title: Director, Global Service Delivery (f/m/d) - EMEA Based (Informatiker/in)
description:
We are a leading global software company dedicated to the world of computer aided design, 3D modeling and simulation— helping innovative global manufacturers design better products, faster! With the resources of a large company, and the energy of a software start-up, we have fun together while creating a world class software portfolio. Our culture encourages creativity, welcomes fresh thinking, and focuses on growth, so our people, our business, and our customers can achieve their full potential.

The Director, Global Service Delivery (SD) is a senior leadership role within Global Engineering Services (GES), part of Siemens' Global Technologies & Infrastructure (GTI) organization. This role owns the end-to-end delivery of engineering support services across three global regions — Americas, EMEA, and APAC — serving approximately 17,000 software engineers worldwide. The Director is accountable for service quality, regional consistency, people leadership, and the ongoing transformation of the SD function.

Please send your CV in English.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Strategic Leadership

- Define and execute the global Service Delivery strategy aligned with GES and GTI priorities.- Set the vision, operating model (Follow-the-Sun), and performance standards for SD across all three regions.- Lead the annual planning cycle for SD: headcount, budget, initiatives, and OKRs.- Represent the SD function at GES leadership reviews, executive briefings, and cross-functional forums.- Drive continuous improvement in service delivery maturity, tooling, and process standardization.

Operational Excellence

- Own the end-to-end SLO/SLA framework for the SD function globally; ensure targets are met and reported.- Partner with the Global Operations Excellence (GOE) team to enforce standards, monitoring, and governance.- Ensure all regions are aligned on tooling, processes, CMDB accuracy, and asset management practices.- Oversee the successful delivery of global programmes (e.g., PCD migration, device refresh, CMDB clean-up…etc).- Identify operational risks and blockers across regions; escalate and resolve proactively.

People Leadership

- Directly lead three Regional SD Leads (Americas, EMEA, APAC) and maintain accountability for the full SD organization.- Build a high-performing, engaged, and geographically distributed team; develop regional leaders and successors.- Drive talent reviews, performance management, and calibration across the SD function.- Champion a culture of accountability, customer focus, and continuous improvement.

Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Engagement

- Serve as the primary SD point of contact for peer GTI functions.- Build and maintain strong relationships with key business stakeholders.- Collaborate with regional SD leads and managers to address customer escalations and service issues.- Provide regular operational reporting to the Senior Director, GES and GTI leadership.

Engineering Segments Engagement

- Own the customer relationship between GES and engineering segments globally; serve as the primary point of contact for segment leads regarding infrastructure, service quality, and engineering productivity.- Establish and maintain a regular engagement cadence with segment representatives to understand development pipeline needs, CI/CD tooling requirements, and environment pain points.- Proactively identify opportunities to improve developer productivity and engineering experience — including build performance, environment stability, tooling access, and onboarding friction.- Collaborate with SD Leads, GOE, and Architecture & Standards teams to translate segment feedback into actionable service improvements and capacity planning inputs.- Track and report on segments satisfaction, developer productivity trends, and GES contribution to engineering velocity — escalate where GES environment is a constraint on delivery.

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE
Required

- Extensive relevant experience in infrastructure management, service delivery, or technology operations, with a significant portion of that time spent in senior leadership — managing global or multi-regional teams at scale.- Proven track record leading large, geographically distributed teams across multiple countries and regions.- Deep understanding of ITSM frameworks (ITIL) and IT governance practices (COBIT or equivalent).- Strong experience managing budgets, headcount planning, and resource allocation at a global scale.- Demonstrated ability to drive transformation programmes and change across complex organizations.- Experience operating in a matrixed, multinational corporate environment.- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; comfortable presenting to executive audiences.- Sound understanding of asset management practices, including CMDB governance, hardware lifecycle management, and software asset inventory at enterprise scale.- Demonstrable knowledge of data center operations and management, including RDC/colocation environments, capacity planning, and infrastructure governance.- Working knowledge of server and storage technologies, including enterprise server platforms, SAN/NAS storage, and backup/recovery frameworks.- Familiarity with vulnerability management processes, including risk prioritization, remediation tracking, and coordination with information security teams to ensure compliance.- Familiarity with software development practices and the software development lifecycle (SDLC); ability to engage credibly with engineering and development teams on environment and tooling requirements.- Working knowledge of CI/CD concepts and common pipeline patterns; exposure to CI/CD platforms, sufficient to understand engineering dependencies and environment requirements.- Understanding of developer workflow tooling and environment needs — including source control, build systems, artifact management, and test infrastructure — as they relate to GES infrastructure provisioning and support.

Preferred

- Background in software engineering, or large-scale enterprise Technology environments.- Hands-on or oversight experience with virtualization technologies (VMware ESXi, OpenStack, or equivalent platforms).- Experience with high-performance or grid computing environments — including job scheduling, compute cluster management, and distributed compute platforms.- Understanding of enterprise networking concepts, sufficient to oversee network-dependent service delivery.- Experience working with or transitioning to cloud-managed or hybrid infrastructure models.- Prior experience in a software engineering, DevOps, or platform engineering role — or significant direct collaboration with software development teams; comfort discussing CI/CD pipelines, build performance, and developer environment requirements.

EDUCATION
Degree — Required

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a closely related technical discipline.- Degrees in other disciplines will be considered where accompanied by strong relevant experience.

Advanced Education — Preferred

- Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering Management, or an MBA with a technology focus.

CERTIFICATIONS
IT Service Management & Governance — Preferred

- ITIL v4 Foundation — required; Managing Professional or Strategic Leader tracks highly valued.- COBIT 2019 Foundation or Practitioner — IT governance and control framework knowledge.- ISO 27001 Lead Implementer or Auditor — advantageous for security governance oversight.

Project & Programme Management — Advantageous

- PMP (Project Management Professional) — PMI.- PRINCE2 Practitioner or PRINCE2 Agile.

LOCATION & TRAVEL
This is a global role with flexibility on base location.
Regular international travel to regional sites and team face-to-face meetings is expected.

REPORTING STRUCTURE
Reports to: Senior Director, Global Engineering Services (GES)
Direct reports: Regional SD Leads — Americas, EMEA, APAC
Functional scope: Full global SD organization

Why us?
A collection of over 377,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we Work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit, and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

Elementar UK, part of the Elementar Group, is responsible for the sales and support of the expanding range of Elemental Analysers and related instruments in the UK as well as being an award-winning manufacturer of Isotope Ratio Mass Spectrometer (IRMS) systems covering a diverse and exciting range of applications.

We research and develop for basic human needs: Our devices ensure quality of life and are used when it comes to water, food, education, health, the environment, climate, energy or product quality.

We are seeking a highly motivated and commercially driven Technical Sales Specialist to generate sustainable and profitable growth for Elementar products and services. This is an exciting opportunity to drive the growth of Elementar's innovative solutions across Ireland and Northern Ireland, taking ownership of a high-potential territory and building lasting customer partnerships.

This is a remote-based role for someone passionate about scientific instrumentation, value-led selling, and developing long-term customer relationships in a technical, solution-focused environment. You’ll work closely with our team in Greater Manchester, where our facilities support the assembly and testing, and house a dedicated Application lab and full R&D team, providing the expertise and resources needed to deliver exceptional customer solutions.

In this role, you will take full ownership of the sales cycle - from prospecting through to closing business and nurturing long-term customer relationships. You will actively develop new sales opportunities by understanding customer needs and applying our technologies to deliver value-driven solutions.

A key part of your role will be presenting both technical and commercial arguments with clarity and confidence, demonstrating how our products and services solve real-world challenges.

You will develop and execute a local business plan in partnership with the Sales Manager, ensuring alignment with growth targets and market opportunities. You'll use market insights and industry trends to identify opportunities, shape local strategy and drive continued growth across your territory, while maintaining accurate sales reporting and forecasting.

Working closely with local service and support teams & the application lab, you will deliver an outstanding customer experience from product demonstration through to after-sales support, while contributing to wider UK sales initiatives when required.

Experience, Essential Skills and Person

We are looking for someone with a degree in a scientific or engineering discipline (or equivalent experience) and at least 5 years’ experience in scientific instrumentation sales or a strong background in technical commercial environments. Experience working with CRM systems such as SAP would be advantageous.

The ideal candidate have a proven track record of winning new business through value-led selling and the ability to identify and convert opportunities within a technical sales environment. You will thrive in an autonomous role, balancing strategic territory development with effective pipeline management to consistently deliver results.

You will possess strong communication skills and be equally comfortable engaging with scientific specialists and non-technical stakeholders, translating complex concepts into meaningful customer value. You should be confident in negotiation, resilient in the face of challenges, and committed to delivering excellent customer experiences. A collaborative mindset, adaptability, and a proactive approach to problem-solving are key to success in this role.

In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
Ballybofey, Co. Donegal | Full-time, Permanent At Glenmore Farming Group, we're committed to building a more sustainable future through innovation in agriculture and renewable energy. Operating across dairy farming, land management, haulage, and anaerobic digestion, we're investing in our people and our facilities as we continue to grow. We are now seeking an experienced Plant Team Leader to join our Anaerobic Digestion Plant in Ballybofey. This is a fantastic opportunity for a motivated engineering professional to step into a hands-on leadership role within one of Ireland's growing renewable energy businesses. Reporting to the Plant Manager, you will lead a team of approximately 10 engineers, ensuring the safe, efficient, and reliable operation of our anaerobic digestion facility. This role combines technical expertise with people leadership. You'll be responsible for coordinating daily activities, supporting preventative and reactive maintenance, monitoring plant performance, and ensuring the highest standards of health, safety, and operational excellence. Whilst this is a supervisory position, we're looking for someone who enjoys remaining hands-on and is willing to work alongside the team whenever required. What you'll be doing Lead, motivate, and develop a team of plant engineers. Plan and coordinate daily engineering and maintenance activities. Support the day-to-day operation of the anaerobic digestion plant. Carry out electrical and mechanical fault finding, repairs, and preventative maintenance. Work closely with the Plant Manager to maximise plant reliability, efficiency, and performance. Promote a positive safety culture and ensure compliance with all health, safety, and environmental procedures. Support continuous improvement initiatives to improve plant performance and reduce downtime. Maintain accurate maintenance records and communicate effectively across operational teams. What we're looking for An engineering qualification with a strong electrical bias. Previous experience leading or supervising engineering or maintenance teams. Strong fault-finding and maintenance experience within an industrial, manufacturing, utilities, renewable energy, or process environment. A practical, hands-on approach with excellent leadership and communication skills. A commitment to safety, quality, and continuous improvement. Experience within anaerobic digestion, biogas, renewable energy, manufacturing, or utilities would be highly advantageous. Why join Glenmore Farming Group? This is more than just another engineering role. It's an opportunity to become part of a progressive business that's investing in renewable energy, sustainable agriculture, and its people. We offer: Competitive salary and benefits package. Ongoing training, development, and career progression opportunities. The opportunity to work with modern plant, equipment, and technology. A supportive, collaborative, and forward-thinking working environ

Collaborate with business leaders, department heads, and operational teams to understand business needs, challenges, and opportunities and translate them into clear and actionable requirements. Support training, onboarding, documentation, and change management activities to assist with the successful adoption of new systems, processes, and technologies. Candidates interested in working within any of these locations are encouraged to apply. Life as a Mammographer (Senior Radiographer) As part of a multidisciplinary breast screening team, you will be responsible for: Producing high-quality mammograms to support the early detection of breast cancer. Capacità comprovata di aprire nuovi mercati e creare reti distributive. Eccellenti capacità negoziali e commerciali. Mentalità imprenditoriale e forte drive al risultato. Capacità di lavorare in autonomia e gestire territori ampi. Esperienza nella gestione di distribuzione e canali agenti. Gestione obiettivi/priorità e capacità di organizzare il lavoro e supportare il team. Ambizioso/a, orientato/a ai risultati, ma anche team player. title: Fahrer (m/w/divers) für Showtruck gesucht (Berufskraftfahrer/in)
description:
.....gesucht wird ein "bewirtender" Berufskraftfahrer oder "kundenorientierter" Gastronom mit Lkw-Führerschein.....

Wir suchen einen zuverlässigen und erfahrenen Lkw-Fahrer mit Führerschein C/CE für unseren Showtruck, der sich um die sichere und effiziente Beförderung unserer Gastronomie-Einrichtung kümmert und nahezu ganzjährig unterwegs ist, insbesondere in Italien und Frankreich.

Als Lkw-Fahrer werden Sie für die Bedienung und Wartung des Fahrzeugs verantwortlich sein und sicherstellen, dass alle Aufgaben im Zusammenhang mit dem Auf- und Abbau der Gastronomie-Einrichtung reibungslos durchgeführt werden. Zu Ihren Hauptaufgaben gehören die Fahrt zu den Veranstaltungsorten, der Auf- und Abbau der Einrichtung, der Ausschank und die Betreuung der Gäste. Wir suchen einen Kandidaten mit ausgeprägten Fahrkenntnissen, excellenten Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und einer tiefen Erfahrung im Umgang mit Lkw und Gastronomie-Einrichtungen.

Die Stelle erfordert eine hohe Flexibilität und die Bereitschaft, nahezu ganzjährig unterwegs zu sein. Wenn Sie eine Herausforderung suchen und sich für eine abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit begeistern, dann sind Sie bei uns richtig.

Zum Aufgabengebiet gehören voraussichtlich aber nicht ausschließlich:

- Mitreisetätigkeit an 6-10 Monaten am Stück im Jahr, ausdehnbar auf 12 Monate im Jahr, wenn erste Teilsaison stimmt
- Erfahrung im Betrieb/Mitreisen bei Schaustellerbetrieben, Eventbereich
- leichter Auf- und Abbau von Gerätschaften während der Tour
- Eventunterstützung von Organisation vor Ort
- Terminplanung Tour
- Ausschankbetrieb
- Führerschein Klasse CE

Persönliche Voraussetzungen:

- Unabhängigkeit
- Altersvorgabe 30-58
- technisches Verständnis Light&Sound und LKW-Technik
- englisch fließend, jede weitere Fremdsprache ist willkommen
- Persönlichkeit: präsent, kommunikativ, selbstbewusst

Interesse? Bitte teilen Sie uns mit, wenn Sie weitere Fragen haben oder wenn Sie sich für diese Stelle interessieren.

Ergänzende Informationen:
Anforderungen an den Bewerber:
Grundkenntnisse: Gästebetreuung, Fahrzeugführung, Getränke zubereiten und anrichten, Technisches Verständnis

title: responsabile di linea di autotrasporti
description: Project Manager - Cantieri navali Nuove Costruzioni L'Azienda Il nostro cliente è uno storico cantiere navale genovese con un consolidato know how nella riparazione e costruzione navale. Il ruolo Nell'ambito dello sviluppo del business delle nuove costruzioni, siamo alla ricerca di un Project Manager che segua la realizzazione delle commesse dalla fase di avvio fino alla consegna finale, garantendo il raggiungimento degli obiettivi contrattuali, tecnici, economici, temporali e qualitativi. Opererà come principale punto di riferimento verso Direzione, Cliente e funzioni interne, coordinando in modo strategico e gestionale tutte le attività necessarie alla corretta esecuzione del progetto. Principali responsabilità Gestire l'intero ciclo di vita della commessa di nuova costruzione, dall'avvio alla consegna finale dell'unità. Pianificare e monitorare il programma generale di commessa, assicurando milestone e scadenze contrattuali. Coordinare funzioni interne e stakeholder (Ufficio Tecnico, Produzione, Procurement, Qualità, HSE, AFC/Controllo di Gestione). Gestire la parte economica della commessa: predisposizione e monitoraggio di budget/forecast, controllo costi, cash flow, analisi scostamenti e azioni correttive a tutela della marginalità. Selezionare e gestire fornitori/subappaltatori/partner: valutazione offerte, controllo prestazioni e gestione criticità/ritardi. Gestire la relazione con Cliente/Armatore/Classifica/Autorità: governance, riunioni di avanzamento, comunicazioni e reporting. Governare aspetti contrattuali e tecnici (varianti, change order, extra work, claim) e assicurare commissioning/HAT/prove in mare, chiusura punch list, non conformità e documentazione finale. Il Profilo Ideale Formazione: Laurea in Ingegneria Navale (valutabili Ingegneria Meccanica/Industriale o titoli equivalenti con consolidata esperienza nel settore). Esperienza: - Consolidata esperienza (almeno 8-10 anni) nel ruolo di Project Manager nel settore navale con un focus sulla costruzione navale o in società del settore marittimo. - Preferibile esperienza presso primari cantieri navali internazionali. - Esperienza su commesse di elevato valore economico e complessità tecnica. Competenze tecniche/gestionali: - Conoscenza dei processi e delle fasi di costruzione navale. - Buona conoscenza di strutture navali, impianti di bordo e discipline tecniche. - Capacità di lettura e interpretazione di specifiche tecniche, contratti, disegni costruttivi e documentazione di commessa. Lingue - Ottimo inglese scritto e parlato (seconda lingua preferenziale). Competenze personali - Leadership su team multidisciplinari e forte orientamento al risultato. - Decision making in contesti complessi, pianificazione e gestione priorità. - Flessibilità e disponibilità a trasferte. Cosa offriamo - Inserimento in un contesto industriale dinamico, in sviluppo nel business Nuove Costruzioni Navali. - Ruolo con responsabilità diretta su commesse complesse e strategiche. - CCNL applicabile: CCNL metalmeccanico-industria - Livello di inquadramento: B3/Q - Fascia di RAL da attribuire alla posizione: 60.000€ - 75.000€ - Benefit: mensa, polizza sanitaria e welfare da CCNL. Sede di lavoro: Genova. #LI-GS2 Wyser S.r.l. è autorizzata ad operare dal Ministero del Lavoro e delle Politiche Sociali (Aut. Min. del 15/04/2014 Prot. N: 39/4903) e si occupa di ricerca e selezione di profili manageriali ed executive. description: Il settore ristorazione ti ha sempre affascinato? Ti piacerebbe svolgere un percorso di formazione gratuito per lavorare come addetto/a alle attività di distribuzione pasti presso mense aziendali e scolastiche, tavole calde e self-service? Questa potrebbe essere l'opportunità giusta per te! Gi Group SpA, Agenzia per il Lavoro Filiale di Castelfranco Veneto organizza un corso di formazione GRATUITO con partenza il 28 settembre 2026 per la figura di: Operatore/Operatrice di Cucina Di cosa si tratta? Il corso ha una durata di 120 ore e approfondirà le seguenti tematiche: - Organizzazione e funzionamento delle mense scolastiche e ospedaliere, tavole calde e self-service - Struttura della mensa, principali mansioni e ruolo dell'addetto mensa - Allestimento e pulizia degli ambienti, delle attrezzature e degli utensili di cucina nel rispetto delle norme HACCP - Pulizia, sanificazione, disinfezione e disinfestazione igienico sanitaria di ambienti, attrezzature e utensili da cucina - Operare la preparazione e somministrazione dei piatti nel rispetto delle norme HACCP - Scodellamento, sporzionamento e gestione della sala - Le muffe, i funghi e i lieviti: gli ambienti favorenti e processi di evitamento e prevenzione - Controllare lo stato di conservazione delle materie prime e dei semilavorati alimentari stoccati - Identificare ed utilizzare i materiali e le confezioni più indicate per proteggere gli alimenti da contaminazioni di tipo chimico e fisico, allungarne la conservazione e trasmettere le informazioni sul prodotto - Tipologie di imballo e caratteristiche di utilizzo per il settore alimentare e celle frigorifere Requisiti: Requisito per la partecipazione al corso è il possesso dell'Assegno Gol rilasciato dal Centro per l'Impiego. Alcune specifiche in più: Il percorso inizierà il 28 settembre 2026 e avrà una durata di 120 e si svolgerà in Modalità Mista (lezioni online e in presenza) presso Via degli Olivi, 1, 31033 Castelfranco Veneto TV. Le lezioni avranno luogo tutti i giorni dal lunedì al venerdì in orario 9:00-14:00. La frequenza consente, in presenza dei requisiti previsti, il riconoscimento del Bonus Politiche Attive, da richiedere presso il Centro per l'Impiego (CPI) competente del territorio. Il corso è finanziato con fondi del PNRR nell'ambito del Programma GOL ed è rivolto a persone disoccupate domiciliate in Veneto. Al termine del corso di formazione i partecipanti saranno seguiti e supportati da un Consulente Gi Group esperto nel Mercato del Lavoro che li accompagnerà nel reinserimento nel mondo del lavoro. Al Termine del corso verrà rilasciato Attestato di Partecipazione. Se sei interessato/a a partecipare a questo percorso, inviaci la tua candidatura! title: COC Master 500GT-3000GT or more than 3000GT (STCW II/2) (Kapitän/in)
description:
The MV Louise Michel is a former French Navy boat we’ve customized to perform search and rescue. Measuring 30 meters in length and capable of up to 28 knots, she was bought with proceeds from the sale of Banksy artwork - who then decorated her with a fire extinguisher. She is operated and crewed by a team of international activist rescue professionals.

- Main responsibilities: handling the ship, overview, control of the vessel and crew safety
- You have the final responsibility for all nautical and technical decisions concerning the operation as well as related crew intructions
- responsible for the ship’s administration (bunkering, crew-lists, customs clearance, detailed operational documentation, daily reports and statistics).
- shiphandling in harbour and during SAR-operations. Together with the officers you will familiarise the crew on the bridge and introduce them to the watch system.
- You will provide the crew with trainings and drills in emergency situations (e.g. what to do in case of fire, POB, ingress of water, unwanted visitors).
- You will work closely with the Head of operations during SAR operations, double checking all decisions against crew and ship safety as well as stability (and guest safety in case of guest already on board).
- You will work closely with the officers and chief engineer

Required:

-EC/EEA-Citizen Passport valid for at least 6 months

-Covid certificate with EU QR code needed, latest vaccine or recovery certificate no older than 180 days or a booster (other nationalities can be transferred to EU certificate)

-Seafarer Medical Certificate (fitness for sea service) according STCW I/9 (Deck Service)

-Proficiency in basic safety (STCW VI/1)

-Proficiency in survival craft and rescue boats other than fast rescue boats (STCW VI/2-1)

-Proficiency in Advanced fire fighting (STCW VI/3)

-Medical First Aid (STCW VI/4-1)

-Medical Care (STCW VI/4-2)

-GMDSS Radio Operator GOC (STCW IV/2)

-COC Master 500GT-3000GT or more than 3000GT (STCW II/2)

-German Endorsement for COC Master Course

-Seafarer's book or the German Seafarer's ID Card

-Excellent and fluent English language skills

-Confidence in decision-making, strong team leading skills, and the ability to cooperate well within a team of volunteers with various levels of nautical experience and skill.

Desired:

- Previous SAR experience
- Italian, French and Arabic language skills

We are currently looking for a Technical Development Manager to SSAB Special Steels in Italy.

SSAB is a highly-specialized global steel company driven by close customer relationships. SSAB Develops high-strength steels and provides services for better perfomance and sustainability. You will be traveling approximately 3-4 days a week to meet customers and also to visit SSAB’s mill in Oxelösund, Sweden.

title: Mystery Shopper in Latvia
description:
Mystery Shopper in Latvia

Work tasks: WHAT OUR MYSTERY SHOPPERS DO
Mystery shoppers do not need to be customer service experts, as their personal opinion is not the deciding factor. However, they must be able to assess customer interactions and the service process objectively. We measure how closely employees’ customer service aligns with their company’s service standards and expectations, enabling businesses to identify development needs and provide targeted training. At the same time, we are confident that our mystery shoppers gradually become customer service professionals themselves. We believe this experience increases their value in the job market, especially in customer-facing roles, as we continuously train and guide our mystery shoppers. Our mystery shoppers are welcome to include “Trendline Mystery Shopper” on their CV. For many employers, this demonstrates a solid understanding of customer service processes. WHAT A TRENDLINE MYSTERY SHOPPER DOES NOT DO Trendline mystery shoppers do not provoke or deliberately challenge employees with difficult or misleading questions. Our mystery shoppers visit service providers, banks, retail stores, and sales organizations. The objective is for the mystery shopper to behave like an ordinary customer. This means they do not ask unusual questions that a typical customer would not ask and do not attempt to provoke employees in any way. Mystery shopping visits are conducted according to scenarios provided by Trendline. After each visit, the mystery shopper submits a detailed report through the Trendline online platform.

We offer: https://trendline.lt
Over 25 years of experience in developing customer service and sales organizations. We operate in Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania. Our services include: mystery shopping, training, customer satisfaction surveys and feedback questionnaires, development of customer service standards, production of training videos, and internal audit tools for managers. We provide our clients with a comprehensive solution—from defining customer service standards and principles to employee training and measuring implementation and performance.

Other requirements: WHAT QUALITIES WE LOOK FOR A mystery shopper should be responsible, friendly, honest,
reliable, and willing to follow instructions carefully while maintaining a professional approach. Before applying for assignments, our mystery shoppers can review the available projects, including the scenario, evaluation questionnaire, job description, and compensation. Once an assignment is confirmed, they are free to complete the mystery shopping visit at any convenient time within the specified timeframe. After completing the visit, the mystery shopper submits a concise evaluation report through the mystery shopper module of our online platform. Our mystery shoppers always have access to our dedicated Mystery Shopper Support Service, which provides ongoing assistance to help them complete assignments to a high standard. Upon request, we also offer additional training, as well as technical and practical support. With more than 25 years of experience in training and customer service development, Trendline knows how to focus on what matters most and provides high-quality training for all mystery shoppers.

Option to work from home: Yes

title: Mystery Shopper in Lithuania
description:
Mystery Shopper in Lithuania

Work tasks: WHAT OUR MYSTERY SHOPPERS DO
Mystery shoppers do not need to be customer service experts, as their personal opinion is not the deciding factor. However, they must be able to assess customer interactions and the service process objectively. We measure how closely employees’ customer service aligns with their company’s service standards and expectations, enabling businesses to identify development needs and provide targeted training. At the same time, we are confident that our mystery shoppers gradually become customer service professionals themselves. We believe this experience increases their value in the job market, especially in customer-facing roles, as we continuously train and guide our mystery shoppers. Our mystery shoppers are welcome to include “Trendline Mystery Shopper” on their CV. For many employers, this demonstrates a solid understanding of customer service processes. WHAT A TRENDLINE MYSTERY SHOPPER DOES NOT DO Trendline mystery shoppers do not provoke or deliberately challenge employees with difficult or misleading questions. Our mystery shoppers visit service providers, banks, retail stores, and sales organizations. The objective is for the mystery shopper to behave like an ordinary customer. This means they do not ask unusual questions that a typical customer would not ask and do not attempt to provoke employees in any way. Mystery shopping visits are conducted according to scenarios provided by Trendline. After each visit, the mystery shopper submits a detailed report through the Trendline online platform.

We offer: https://trendline.lt
Over 25 years of experience in developing customer service and sales organizations. We operate in Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania. Our services include: mystery shopping, training, customer satisfaction surveys and feedback questionnaires, development of customer service standards, production of training videos, and internal audit tools for managers. We provide our clients with a comprehensive solution—from defining customer service standards and principles to employee training and measuring implementation and performance.

Other requirements: WHAT QUALITIES WE LOOK FOR
A mystery shopper should be responsible, friendly, honest, reliable, and willing to follow instructions carefully while maintaining a professional approach. Before applying for assignments, our mystery shoppers can review the available projects, including the scenario, evaluation questionnaire, job description, and compensation. Once an assignment is confirmed, they are free to complete the mystery shopping visit at any convenient time within the specified timeframe. After completing the visit, the mystery shopper submits a concise evaluation report through the mystery shopper module of our online platform. Our mystery shoppers always have access to our dedicated Mystery Shopper Support Service, which provides ongoing assistance to help them complete assignments to a high standard. Upon request, we also offer additional training, as well as technical and practical support. With more than 25 years of experience in training and customer service development, Trendline knows how to focus on what matters most and provides high-quality training for all mystery shoppers.

Option to work from home: Yes

description: Statut : Employé, Fonctionnaire Qui recrute ? La météorologie aéronautique est une discipline scientifique exigeant/ante qui repose sur l'analyse de phénomènes s complexes, l'interprétation de modèles numériques et la prise de décisions en temps réel. Pour réussir dans cette fonction ainsi que dans la formation spécialisée dispensée par nos partenaires internationaux, un intérêt marqué pour les sciences ainsi que de solides bases en mathématiques, et sciences de la nature constituent de véritables atouts. Le poste s'exerce dans le cadre d'un service continu heures sur et 7 jours sur 7, selon un système de travail en équipes comprenant les soirées, les nuits, les week-ends et les jours fériés. Ce que l'ANA a à vous offrir : L'ANA investit pleinement dans votre développement professionnel. Vous bénéficierez d'une formation spécialisée en météorologie entier/ièrement financée par l'ANA, d'une durée de à mois, auprès d'institutions européennes de référence telles que : Le Deutscher Wetterdienst (DWD) à Langen (Allemagne) ; L'École Nationale de la Météorologie de Météo-France à Toulouse (France). Cette formation couvre notamment : La de l'atmosphère ; La thermodynamique ; La dynamique des fluides ; Les mathématiques appliquées ; Les modèles numériques de prévision ; La météorologie aéronautique ; L'analyse scientifique des phénomènes météorologiques. La réussite de cette formation nécessite une réelle appétence pour les disciplines scientifiques ainsi qu'une forte capacité d'apprentissage et d'analyse. Le recrutement des prévisionnistes en météorologie est particulier/ièrement exigeant afin de garantir la réussite de la formation spécialisée et l'exercice d'une fonction essentielle à la sécurité aérien/ienne. Le processus de sélection comprend plusieurs étapes : Analyse des candidatures et vérification des conditions d'admission; Test d'anglais; Épreuves écrites visant notamment à évaluer : Les capacités de raisonnement scientifique et logique ; Les connaissances générales en mathématiques, et sciences ; Les aptitudes analytiques. Entretien devant une commission de sélection, permettant d'apprécier la motivation, les compétences comportementales, la capacité d'apprentissage et l'adéquation du candidat avec les exigences de la fonction. Compte tenu du niveau d'exigence de la formation et des responsabilités confiées aux prévisionnistes, seuls les candidats démontrant de solides aptitudes scientifiques, analytiques et comportementales pourront poursuivre le processus de sélection. Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. How will you contribute?

In the framework of the MSCA Rescue project, you will be mainly in charge of:
•         Developing a context-sensitive methodology for assessing and monitoring soil health at contaminated sites using geophysical characterisation methods
•         Integrating soil health descriptors, ecosystem services, and EU regulatory frameworks (including the Soil Monitoring Law) into a unified assessment approach applicable across urban and peri-urban settings
•         Evaluating site-specific phytomanagement strategies through multi-criteria analysis connecting biophysical and economic descriptors
•       Building and enhancing the existing NBenefit$ tool of LIST by combining system dynamic modelling of ecological processes, life cycle assessment (LCA), and life cycle costing (LCC) into an evidence-based simulation framework
•         Applying the enhanced NBenefit$ tool to a real case study in Wallonia in collaboration with industry partner Siterem
•         Collaborating with Doctoral Candidate of Linköping University (DC14) on joint synthesis work contributing to the overall objectives of WP4
•         Engaging in four secondments for a total of 12 months at University of Gent (3 moths); Linköping University (4 months); University of Milano-Bicocca (4 months); Siterem-Belgium (1 month):

Is Your profile described below? Are you our future colleague? Apply now!

Education
•        Master's degree (or equivalent) in Environmental Science, Environmental Engineering, Industrial Ecology, Soil Science or a closely related field
•           Academic background covering topics such as soil science, soil remediation technologies, life cycle assessment, ecosystem services, soil ecology, phytoremediation and bioremediation, geophysics
•           Up to 2 years of experience (including research, academic work or courses) in soil assessment, contaminated land management, or related fields

Hard skills:
•         Familiarity with soil health indicators, ecosystem services assessment, and phytomanagement strategies
•         Experience with or strong interest in system dynamic modelling
•         Knowledge of life cycle assessment (LCA) and/or life cycle costing (LCC) methodologies is an asset

•         Knowledge of EU soil-related regulatory frameworks (e.g., Soil Monitoring Law) is an asset

Soft skills:
•         Strong integrative thinking, able to connect biophysical, economic, and regulatory dimensions
•         Ability to work in a multidisciplinary and international research environment
•         Proactive and autonomous, with strong organisational skills

Language skills

title: Event & Corporate Communication Manager (m/f/x)
description:
Event & Corporate Communication Manager (m/f/x)

Paperjam, founded in 1994 by Mike Koedinger, has become Luxembourg's most influential independent media and business platform. Beyond being a trusted source for economic, financial, and political journalism, Paperjam acts as a catalyst for innovation, community, and the country's development.

Its main activities:

• Paperjam News: reliable and relevant coverage of economic, financial, and political topics.
• Paperjam Club: Luxembourg's leading private business club, offering conferences, workshops, networking, and an academy.
• Paperjam Advertising: an advertising agency specializing in targeted, high-impact campaigns.
• Paperjam Studio: a creative agency helping brands with storytelling and visual communication.

In short: Paperjam positions itself as an independent, influential, and forward-looking player, shaping a progressive Luxembourg.

The Paperjam Club, Luxembourg's premier business club, supports its members in expanding their network and discovering new business opportunities, enhancing their visibility and brand, as well as developing their teams' skills. Through the Academy and a rich agenda of content, events, and unique experiences (business, sports, culture, wellness), our 1,800 member companies benefit from an exclusive ecosystem to accelerate their growth and influence within the Luxembourg business community.

We are looking for a talented Event & Corporate Communication Manager (m/f/x).

The Communication Manager Events & Employer Brand is responsible for developing and delivering integrated communication strategies that strengthen the visibility, reputation and impact of the Paperjam Club and the Paperjam brand across all Paperjam communication channels.
The role designs, manages and executes the annual Paperjam Club communication plan and leads the promotion of Club events before, during and after each event. It also drives Paperjam's employer branding and coordinates corporate communication initiatives in collaboration with Human Resources and the Executive Committee.
Working closely with the Club Director and all Club teams, the Communication Manager combines strategic thinking, creativity, strong writing skills, data-driven decision-making and AI-assisted communication to maximise audience engagement, brand awareness and business impact.

Key Responsibilities

Communication & Events

• Design, manage and execute the annual communication plan in line with the Club's strategic objectives ;
• Design and maintain communication kits for each event format, defining key messages, content, assets, channels and timelines to ensure consistent and effective promotion ;
• Develop integrated campaigns across all Paperjam communication channels, ensuring consistent messaging, positioning and editorial quality ;
• Lead communication for Paperjam Club events before, during and after each event to maximise registrations, engagement, partner visibility and post-event impact ;
• Identify new trends, formats and communication opportunities to strengthen the visibility of the Paperjam Club and Paperjam brands.

Content, Social Media & Community Management

• Write, edit and coordinate high-quality content across social media, newsletters, websites, media partners, advertising, video, photography and print ;
• Lead the day-to-day community management of Paperjam Club's social media channels and foster active, engaged online communities ;
• Develop platform-specific content strategies to increase audience growth, visibility and engagement ;
• Monitor social media performance and continuously optimise content based on analytics and audience insights ;
• Support Paperjam journalists in optimising the reach and impact of their content on social media.

Employer Branding & Corporate Communication

• Develop and promote Paperjam's employer brand across all Paperjam communication channels ;
• Showcase Paperjam's culture, values, people and career opportunities through compelling content and storytelling ;
• Coordinate corporate communication initiatives in collaboration with Human Resources and the Executive Committee ;
• Ensure consistency across event, employer brand and corporate communication.

Performance, Innovation & AI

• Monitor communication performance through defined KPIs and recommend data-driven improvements ;
• Use AI as an integral part of everyday communication workflows to enhance creativity, productivity and campaign performance while maintaining editorial quality and brand consistency ;
• Stay ahead of communication trends, social media developments and emerging technologies.

Profile

• Ideally a Master's degree in Communication, Marketing, Journalism or a related field ;
• Minimum 3–5 years of relevant experience in communication, marketing or event communication ;
• Strong interest in Luxembourg's business environment and in economic, technological and sustainability topics ;
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in French and English, with strong writing, editing and storytelling abilities ;
• Proven experience developing integrated communication campaigns and managing social media communities ;
• Excellent command of LinkedIn, Instagram and YouTube, including platform-specific content creation, community engagement and audience development ;
• Experience with additional social media platforms such as TikTok, Facebook, X, Threads or emerging platforms is an asset ;
• Experience with a social media management platform such as Hootsuite, Sprout Social, Agorapulse, Buffer or equivalent is an asset ;
• Experience with Canva, Adobe Creative Cloud and video content production ;
• Strong project management and organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines ;
• Creative, proactive, collaborative and results-oriented, with a strong analytical mindset ;
• Comfortable using AI-powered communication and content creation tools as part of everyday work.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means:

• Increasing the visibility, attractiveness and impact of Paperjam Club events ;
• Growing and engaging qualified audiences across all Paperjam communication channels ;
• Building active and engaged social media communities ;
• Delivering high-quality content and campaigns that generate measurable impact ;
• Strengthening Paperjam's employer brand and corporate reputation ;
• Continuously improving communication performance through data, innovation and AI-assisted ways of working.

We offer you

• A company with an excellent reputation and deeply rooted in the economic fabric of Luxembourg and the Greater Region ;
• A stimulating environment where your contribution directly impacts the growth and reputation of the leading business club in Luxembourg
• Ideally located offices in Luxembourg City, just a 5-minute walk from the central train station ;
• A permanent full-time contract (40 hours/week) ;
• Start date: to be agreed upon.

To apply

Are you interested in the challenge? Please send us your application file (CV, cover letter, etc.). Each application will be treated with the utmost confidentiality.

Avec cartes et plans couvrant des représentations du monde, du Luxembourg et de ses territoires, cette collection se distingue comme l'une des plus remarquables du pays. title: Cartographe (m/f) (réf. E) (réf. F) (réf. M) (H/F)
description: Statut : Employé, Fonctionnaire Qui recrute ? La Bibliothèque nationale du Luxembourg (BnL) s'engage dans un nouveau programme visant à améliorer l'accessibilité de ses collections, en particulier celles des Fonds spéciaux, qui abritent des trésors patrimoniaux uniques : cartes historiques, plans, atlas, vues topographiques et documents cartographiques rares. Avec cartes et plans couvrant des représentations du monde, du Luxembourg et de ses territoires, cette collection se distingue comme l'une des plus remarquables du pays. Pourtant, cette collection reste non cataloguée, donc inaccessible en ligne. La BnL cherche à renforcer l'équipe patrimoniale avec un expert polyvalent, capable de gérer des tâches complexes liées à la préservation et à l'accessibilité du patrimoine. Missions Catalogage et valorisation des collections: Enrichir les métadonnées, référencer, cataloguer, indexer et exemplariser les documents des Fonds spéciaux, surtout les cartes, plans, atlas, vues, selon les normes en vigueur (SIGB Alma, RDA, Rameau, DDC); Structurer les critères de collection pour les documents cartographiques, en collaboration avec l'équipe patrimoniale; Établir une charte d'acquisition et une politique de conservation adaptées aux spécificités des fonds cartographiques; Contrôler la cohérence du développement du Fonds des cartes, plans et atlas, en veillant à son alignement avec les objectifs stratégiques de la BnL. Gestion et accessibilité numérique: Piloter la numérisation des collections cartographiques; Valoriser les collections à l'aide des nouvelles technologies (humanités numériques, outils de recherche scientifique) pour en faciliter l'accès au public et aux chercheurs; Collaborer avec les services IT pour intégrer les données cartographiques dans les plateformes numériques de la BnL (eluxemburgensia). Conservation et expertise: Assurer la préservation des documents (conditions de stockage, restauration si nécessaire); Participer à des projets de recherche en lien avec les collections, en collaboration avec des institutions nationales ou internationales. La mission couvre l'ensemble du cycle Meta Ads, de l'audit et la définition de la stratégie jusqu'à la création, au lancement et à l'optimisation continue des campagnes sur Facebook et Instagram, avec une approche résolument orientée performance, conversions et rentabilité. Vos responsabilités Stratégie & Audit Meta Ads Auditer les comptes publicitaires existants et identifier rapidement les opportunités d'amélioration. Définir les stratégies d'acquisition en fonction des objectifs, du marché et du budget de chaque client. Structurer les comptes et campagnes afin de maximiser leur efficacité. Définir les audiences, objectifs de campagne et parcours de conversion adaptés. Création & Gestion des Campagnes Créer, paramétrer et gérer des campagnes Facebook Ads et Instagram Ads via Meta Ads Manager. Piloter des campagnes de génération de leads, trafic, conversions, ventes et retargeting. Construire et optimiser les audiences : ciblage, Custom Audiences, Lookalike Audiences et retargeting. Structurer les campagnes, ensembles de publicités et annonces. Définir les angles publicitaires et recommandations créatives adaptés aux différentes audiences. Tester différents formats, messages, visuels, vidéos et appels à l'action. Budget & Optimisation Piloter les budgets et stratégies d'enchères. Identifier les campagnes, audiences, placements et créations les plus performants. Mettre en place des A/B tests et expérimentations afin d'améliorer continuellement les résultats. Analyser la fréquence, le coût d'acquisition et la fatigue créative. Ajuster les investissements en fonction des performances et des objectifs de rentabilité. Tracking & Analytics Mettre en place, vérifier et optimiser le Meta Pixel. Maîtriser les problématiques liées à la Conversions API (CAPI) et au tracking server-side. Utiliser Google Analytics 4 et Google Tag Manager pour compléter l'analyse des performances. Vérifier la qualité et la fiabilité du tracking des événements et conversions. Comprendre les problématiques d'attribution entre Meta et les autres canaux d'acquisition. Performance & ROI Suivre les principaux KPI : CPM, CTR, CPC, CPL, CPA, taux de conversion et ROAS. Analyser les performances et transformer les données en actions concrètes. Identifier les audiences, campagnes et créations générant les meilleurs résultats. Concevoir des reportings clairs orientés performance, conversions et ROI. Fournir des recommandations concrètes et priorisées pour chaque client. Assurer une veille régulier/ière sur les évolutions de Meta Ads et les nouvelles fonctionnalités de la plateforme. Profil recherché Expérience : expérience solide et démontrable dans la gestion et l'optimisation de campagnes Meta Ads, idéalement sur plusieurs secteurs d'activité. Meta Ads : excellente maîtrise de Meta Ads Manager et de la gestion de campagnes Facebook et Instagram. Acquisition : bonne compréhension des stratégies de génération de leads, conversion et retargeting. Tracking : bonne maîtrise du Meta Pixel, des événements de conversion et bonne compréhension de la Conversions API. Analytics : bonne connaissance de Google Analytics 4 et Google Tag Manager. Créatives : capacité à analyser les performances des créations et à formuler des recommandations sur les angles, messages, formats et contenus à tester. Performance : approche fortement orientée ROI et rentabilité, au-delà des simples métriques de visibilité ou d'engagement. Analyse : capacité à interpréter les données et à transformer rapidement les résultats en actions d'optimisation concrètes. Organisation : excellente capacité à gérer plusieurs comptes et projets simultanément et à travailler de manier/ière autonome. Qualités : autonomie, rigueur, proactivité et capacité à formuler des recommandations. Références : la capacité à présenter des cas concrets de campagnes gérées, budgets pilotés et résultats obtenus sera particulier/ièrement appréciée. Détails de la collaboration Statut : Freelance / Indépendant Localisation :  % télétravail / Remote Démarrage : Dès que possible Type de clients : Principalement TPE / PME Mode de collaboration : Au forfait ou en régie selon les projets Candidature Merci d'envoyer votre CV à . Pour toute information complémentaire, vous pouvez nous contacter au + .

title: DEEP - Cloud Systems Architect - Cloud Souverain (H/F)
description: Afin de renforcer les équipes de DEEP au sein de Business Line Cloud, nous recherchons actuellement un(e) DEEP - Cloud Systems Architect - Cloud Souverain (m/f/n) à temps plein.Vos missions Concevoir et spécifier des architectures cloud complexes sur OVH Public Cloud, Clever Cloud et, selon les besoins, OPCP, en garantissant leur performance, leur sécurité, leur résilience et leur conformité. Analyser les besoins métiers et techniques des clients, définir les trajectoires de transformation et élaborer les architectures et services cibles adaptées aux contraintes d'exploitation, de sécurité, de souveraineté et de time-to-market. Accompagner les projets de migration et de modernisation d'infrastructures et de plateformes applicatives vers OVH Public Cloud, Clever Cloud et des approches cloud native basées sur Kubernetes et services managés. Diriger ou encadrer l'intégration des composants techniques nécessaires aux solutions retenues : réseau, sécurité, IAM, observabilité, sauvegarde, CI/CD, registry, plateformes Kubernetes, services de données et composants d'automatisation. Garantir l'intégration de la sécurité dès la conception (security by design), ainsi que l'application des bonnes pratiques de résilience, de continuité, de sauvegarde, de conformité et de gouvernance. Piloter la standardisation et l'industrialisation des plateformes via l'Infrastructure as Code, l'automatisation, les pratiques DevOps/GitOps et les pipelines de déploiement. Définir et faire appliquer les architectures de référence pour les environnements cloud native, incluant les aspects de déploiement, d'observabilité, de logging, de gestion des secrets, de sécurité et de cycle de vie des plateformes. Apporter une expertise d'architecture sur les sujets PaaS, plateformes conteneurisées, intégration applicative, services managés et écosystèmes open source liés au cloud native. Jouer un rôle de référent technique auprès des équipes d'ingénierie, d'exploitation, de delivery, d'avant-vente et des clients, afin de sécuriser les choix techniques et de favoriser l'adoption des solutions définies. Assurer une veille technologique active et proposer des évolutions pertinentes sur les services OVH, Clever Cloud, les technologies cloud native et les approches d'automatisation afin d'enrichir les offres et les plateformes de DEEP. Réaliser des missions de consultance en architecture auprès des clients, afin de les accompagner dans la définition de leurs trajectoires cloud, l'évaluation des choix techniques et la conception de solutions adaptées à leurs enjeux métier et techniques. Supporter, concevoir et faire émerger de nouveaux services autour de ses domaines de compétence (cloud public, cloud native, architecture, automatisation, plateforme), en participant à la définition des standards, des briques techniques, de la documentation et du positionnement de ces services dans le catalogue de l'entreprise. Votre profil Disposer d'une formation de niveau Master spécialisée en informatique, systèmes, réseaux et cloud, et/ou d'une expérience professionnelle équivalente. Disposer d'une expérience significative dans la conception, l'intégration ou l'évolution d'architectures cloud pour des clients, avec une capacité démontrée à cadrer des solutions complexes. Maîtriser les concepts et architectures IaaS, PaaS, KaaS, cloud public, cloud souverain et services managés. Avoir une connaissance d'OVH Public Cloud et/ou de Clever Cloud. Maîtriser les principes d'architecture cloud native et les plateformes conteneurisées, en particulier Kubernetes et l'écosystème associé. Connaître plusieurs technologies cloud native et DevOps parmi les suivant/antes : GitLab, Keycloak, Nexus, SonarQube, FluxCD, Crossplane, Velero, Kasten, RabbitMQ, Kafka, OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Elasticsearch, Prometheus, AKS, EKS ou équivalents. Avoir une bonne connaissance dans les pratiques d'automatisation et d'Infrastructure as Code telles que Terraform, Ansible ou équivalents, ainsi que les approches CI/CD et GitOps. Être capable d'intégrer les exigences de sécurité, de conformité, de gouvernance et d'exploitabilité dans les choix d'architecture. Disposer de solides compétences rédactionnelles pour formaliser les architectures, les dossiers techniques et les standards de mise en œuvre. Intéressé(e) ? Envie de relever un nouveau défi professionnel dans une entreprise multiculturelle et dynamique, qui investit dans le développement et le bien-être de ses collaborateurs ? Rejoignez-nous en cliquant sur Postuler Une copie conforme de votre diplôme et une copie récente de l'extrait du  vous seront demandées au cours du processus de recrutement. POST souscrit au principe de l'égalité d'accès à l'emploi

title: Data Protection Officer (M/F/X) (H/F)
