title: Médecin militaire (m/f) (H/F)
description: Statut : Fonctionnaire Qui recrute ? L'Armée luxembourgeoise est une force militaire moderne et professionnelle. Composée d'hommes et de femmes dévoués, elle a pour mission principale de défendre la souveraineté et l'intégrité du Grand-Duché, de contribuer à la sécurité nationale et internationale, et de participer aux opérations de maintien de la paix sous l'égide de l'OTAN, de l'Union européenne et des Nations Unies. Engagée dans un environnement multinational, l'Armée luxembourgeoise offre un cadre de travail où l'esprit d'équipe et le sens du devoir occupent une place centrale. Rejoindre l'Armée luxembourgeoise, c'est: Servir son pays dans un cadre porteur de valeurs fortes : droiture, engagement et fiabilité; Développer ses compétences à travers une formation continue et personnalisée; Évoluer dans une carrier/ière riche en opportunité et missions variées. Missions Le médecin militaire est le dernier maillon de la chaîne e sur le terrain des opérations, après le Combat Med et l'infirmier militaire; En mission, il est capable de prendre en charge des militaires blessés dans toutes les conditions; Sa formation lui permet d'appliquer ses compétences es dans un environnement militaire soumis à des contraintes tactiques et logistiques. Selon sa spécialisation, il peut exercer: En Role 1 : prise en charge visant à garantir la survie du patient dans des conditions dégradées, selon le principe du damage control resuscitation; En Role 2 : prise en charge incluant une capacité chirurgicale d'urgence, reposant sur le damage control surgery, privilégiant la rapidité et le contrôle des lésions vitales plutôt que leur réparation définitive immédiate; Pour entretenir ses compétences cliniques, le médecin militaire exerce également dans le domaine clinique civil. Profil Compétences techniques Être déployable pour toutes les missions et formations de l'Armée; Suivre les formations nécessaires; Maîtriser les outils bureautiques de base; Avoir de bonnes connaissances des opérations et missions de l'Armée luxembourgeoise; Avoir des connaissances de base en gestion des ressources humaines et logistiques. Compétences comportementales Faire preuve de sollicitude, de justice et d'impartialité; Donner l'exemple par la façon de se comporter et d'accomplir ses devoirs; Être ouvert aux relations interpersonnelles; Faire preuve de compétences de leadership; Faire preuve de professionnalisme; Adhérer aux valeurs-phares de l'Armée (engagement-droiture-fiabilité). Conditions d'admission Diplômes Vous êtes titulaire d'un grade ou diplôme délivré par un établissement d'enseignement supérieur reconnu par l'État du siège de l'établissement et sanctionnant l'accomplissement avec succès d'un master en Médecin spécialiste en traumatologie et médecine d'urgence ou de son équivalent. Le grade ou diplôme requis doit correspondre au moins au niveau 7 tel que défini par le Cadre luxembourgeois des qualifications. Vous disposez de l'autorisation d'exercer la profession. Langues Vous répondez aux exigences de connaissances des 3 langues administratives pour le groupe de traitement A1.  Vous avez la  luxembourgeoise. Être reconnu ement et psychologiquement apte pour le service militaire. Avoir une présentation compatible avec l'exercice de la fonction et le port d'uniforme.   Examen-concours: Examen-concours au Centre militaire du  au  octobre  Épreuve sportive, épreuves de langues, tests psychotechniques, épreuve de connaissances générales, évaluation psychologique et entretien de motivation. Incorporation janvier

title: Concepteur d'offres de formation (m/f) (réf. E) (réf. F) (réf. M) (H/F)
description: Statut : Employé, Fonctionnaire Qui recrute ? Accompagner les établissements dans la mise en place des offres de formation interne: Être à l'écoute des établissements et susciter leur intérêt dans la mise en place d'offres de formation répondant à des besoins spécifiques; Assister les établissements dans la mise en place d'offres de formation (projet spécifique pour chaque établissement avec suivi rapproché, conseil, support et aide à la mise en place); Veiller avec les établissements à la mise en œuvre et au bon déroulement des offres de formation. Évaluer les offres de formation: Procéder avec les publics cibles et les établissements concernés à l'évaluation des offres de formation; Mesurer les résultats obtenus surtout dans le domaine de l'amélioration des compétences des agents ayant suivi des actions de formation. Assurer un accueil auprès des participants et des formateurs: Renseigner, conseiller, orienter et clarifier selon les besoins exprimés. Contribuer à l'évolution du dispositif et à la gestion de la qualité: Veiller au respect des procédures liées à l'exercice de la fonction; Contribuer à l'évolution des procédures liées à l'exercice de la fonction. Profil Compétences techniques Connaître les théories et modèles du développement scolaire; Connaître les approches systémiques appliquées aux organisations éducatives; Connaître les principes du leadership pédagogique et du leadership distribué; Connaître les processus de conduite du changement; Connaître les principes de l'apprentissage organisationnel; Connaître les démarches d'évaluation et d'amélioration continue des établissements scolaires; Connaître les politiques éducatives...

title: Assistant General Manager (h/f/d)/ Deputy General Manager (h/f/d) (H/F)
description: Assistant General Manager (h/f/d)/ Deputy General Manager (h/f/d) Company Description. En tant qu'Assistant Captain, tu as l'œil pour les détails et tu sais ce qui est attendu de toi pour offrir une expérience MOXY aux clients. Tu es proactif, amical et serviable, ainsi qu'un leader reconnu pour l'équipe. En tant qu'Assistant Captain, tu as une forte connexion avec les clients et les valeurs fondamentales de la marque thoughtful, fun et spirited. Tu comprends et harmonises avec la vision MOXY et tu canalises son énergie pour offrir à chaque client et chaque membre de l'équipage l'expérience MOXY. title: Prévisionniste en météorologie (m/f) (réf. E) (réf. F) (réf. M) (H/F)
description: Statut : Employé, Fonctionnaire Qui recrute ? L'Administration de la navigation aérien/ienne (ANA), rattachée au ministère de la Mobilité et des Travaux publics, est le fournisseur de services de navigation aérien/ienne du Luxembourg, basée à Findel. Notre mission est de garantir un trafic aérien sûr, efficace et respectueux de l'environnement dans les espaces aériens nationaux et délégués ainsi qu'à l'aérodrome. Missions Afin de renforcer notre département Météorologie, nous recrutons un(e) Prévisionniste en météorologie. En rejoignant notre équipe, vous participerez directement à une mission d'intérêt public essentielle : assurer la sécurité des opérations aérien/iennes grâce à une expertise météorologique de haut niveau, tout en contribuant aux missions météorologiques nationales. La météorologie aéronautique est une discipline scientifique exigeant/ante qui repose sur l'analyse de phénomènes s complexes, l'interprétation de modèles numériques et la prise de décisions en temps réel. Pour réussir dans cette fonction ainsi que dans la formation spécialisée dispensée par nos partenaires internationaux, un intérêt marqué pour les sciences ainsi que de solides bases en mathématiques, et sciences de la nature constituent de véritables atouts. Vous serez notamment chargé(e) de : Analyser et interpréter les observations et données météorologiques (satellites, radars, réseaux de détection de la foudre, modèles numériques, etc.) ; Élaborer, actualiser et diffuser les prévisions météorologiques nationales et aéronautiques ; Produire les messages météorologiques destinés aux usagers de l'aviation conformément aux normes internationales ; Assurer une veille météorologique permanente et diffuser les alertes en cas de phénomènes dangereux ; Fournir une assistance météorologique aux pilotes, aux services de la navigation aérien/ienne et aux autres partenaires opérationnels ; Collaborer avec les organismes météorologiques nationaux et internationaux ; Contribuer au maintien et à l'amélioration continue du système de management de la qualité, de la sécurité et de l'environnement du département ; Promouvoir et appliquer les principes de la Just Culture au sein de l'ANA. Le poste s'exerce dans le cadre d'un service continu heures sur et 7 jours sur 7, selon un système de travail en équipes comprenant les soirées, les nuits, les week-ends et les jours fériés. Ce que l'ANA a à vous offrir : L'ANA investit pleinement dans votre développement professionnel. Vous bénéficierez d'une formation spécialisée en météorologie entier/ièrement financée par l'ANA, d'une durée de à mois, auprès d'institutions européennes de référence telles que : Le Deutscher Wetterdienst (DWD) à Langen (Allemagne) ; L'École Nationale de la Météorologie de Météo-France à Toulouse (France). Cette formation couvre notamment : La de l'atmosphère ; La thermodynamique ; La dynamique des fluides ; Les mathématiques appliquées ; Les modèles numériques de prévision ; La météorologie aéronautique ; L'analyse scientifique des phénomènes météorologiques. La réussite de cette formation nécessite une réelle appétence pour les disciplines scientifiques ainsi qu'une forte capacité d'apprentissage et d'analyse. Le recrutement des prévisionnistes en météorologie est particulier/ièrement exigeant afin de garantir la réussite de la formation spécialisée et l'exercice d'une fonction essentielle à la sécurité aérien/ienne. Le processus de sélection comprend plusieurs étapes : Analyse des candidatures et vérification des conditions d'admission; Test d'anglais; Épreuves écrites visant notamment à évaluer : Les capacités de raisonnement scientifique et logique ; Les connaissances générales en mathématiques, et sciences ; Les aptitudes analytiques. Entretien devant une commission de sélection, permettant d'apprécier la motivation, les compétences comportementales, la capacité d'apprentissage et l'adéquation du candidat avec les exigences de la fonction. Compte tenu du niveau d'exigence de la formation et des responsabilités confiées aux prévisionnistes, seuls les candidats démontrant de solides aptitudes scientifiques, analytiques et comportementales pourront poursuivre le processus de sélection. Exercer une profession scientifique passionnant/ante ayant un impact direct sur la sécurité aérien/ienne ; Intégrer une administration moderne, dynamique et tournée vers l'innovation ; Évoluer aux côtés de spécialistes reconnus dans leur domaine ; Bénéficier d'un parcours de formation de très haut niveau reconnu à l'échelle européenne ; Développer continuellement vos compétences dans un environnement international ; Partager les valeurs de l'ANA : Intégrité, Respect, Innovation, Engagement et Excellence. Vous êtes prêt(e) à relever ce défi ? Postulez dès aujourd'hui et devenez acteur...

ISO ); Familiarité avec les procédures administratives de sanction; Expérience dans un des secteurs visés par l'annexe de la loi du 5 mai  sur la résilience des entités critiques. Conditions d'admission Le poste peut être brigué sous le statut du fonctionnaire de l'État. Il est ouvert au changement d'administration des fonctionnaires. title: Regional Controller (m/f)
description:
Regional Controller

Location(s) Luxembourg, Luxembourg
Career Field Accounting & Finance
Job Number 192657

Your Job

Guardian is looking for motivated Regional Controller with a passion for transformation and eager to advance into their career. This position is responsible for the financial oversight of multiple manufacturing facilities within Europe by partnering with different teams to ensure delivery of controlling activities to expected level.

Our Team

This role has the opportunity cross-functionally work with diverse and experienced capabilities within Guardian and Koch in a mutually beneficial way to drive results for the company.

The role is based in Luxembourg.

What You Will Do

• Work cross functionally with multiple departments (operations, accounting etc.)  to ensure the core monthly financial statements - B/S, P&L, CFS - are produced timely and materially correct.
• Track, analyze, and report budget and profitability variance to leadership. Partner with different teams to obtain a reliable understanding over monthly business activity and events, provide support to accounting team to accurately capture the activity into financials. Drive/support successful execution of complex corporate transactions and business changes (mergers, liquidations, loan repayments, dividends etc.).
• Partner with local compliance team to ensure an accurate local result is reported in the statutory financial statements (e.g., support during audit/review of FS mapping). Accountability on accurate and timely submissions status of local filings (FS/VAT/CIT).
• Continuously seek and drive transformative improvements to organization, accounting processes and system utilization for controlling activities (e.g., overall process improvement and application of internal financial controls), ensure appropriate governance and follow-up on long-term open transactions.

Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)

• Master's degree in accounting or finance.
• Experience in accounting and/or analytical finance roles.
• Experience working with multiple legal entities under different legal umbrellas.
• Excellent communication and presentation skills; comfortable interacting regularly with the leadership team.
• Fluent in English (written and spoken).
• Strong Excel skills.
• Self-motivated with strong initiative and the ability to act independently.

What Will Put You Ahead

• Previous experience in a controller role
• Experience with US GAAP

title: Audit Manager in Commercial and Industrial Companies (m/f)
description:
Audit Manager in Commercial and Industrial Companies
Location:  Luxembourg, LU
Company:  Deloitte Luxembourg
Job Function:  Audit & Assurance
Seniority:  Manager levels
Contract Type:  Open-term
On site Full time

Your future team

For our Audit & Assurance practice, audit is about much more than numbers. It is about attesting to accomplishments and challenges, and helping to ensure strong foundations for future ambitions.

At Deloitte Luxembourg, we are committed to making an impact that matters for our clients, our people and society. We continuously develop our expertise and challenge ourselves to deliver high-quality work. To support our growth, we are looking for experienced audit professionals who want to help shape the future of our practice and contribute to our clients' success.

The advantages of joining us

Why you'll thrive at Deloitte:

• Work with recognized experts and be part of a dynamic team delivering high value audit services to prestigious clients in the commercial, industrial and public sectors
• Access top notch training and career development with a clear progression path
• Build your network through our global Deloitte community and local industry events
• Enjoy an inclusive and flexible culture that values collaboration, respect and diverse perspectives
• Profit from an attractive package of customizable advantages

How you'll contribute to our success

• Provide audit services to a portfolio of clients in the commercial, industrial, public and other sectors, ensuring high-quality and timely delivery
• Demonstrate a strong understanding of regulation, risk management and internal controls, and their impact on business processes
• Coordinate audit engagements, including planning, day to day execution, communication with key client stakeholders and adherence to deadlines
• Build and maintain strong client relationships, acting as a trusted main point of contact and collaborating with other teams across the firm
• Coach, mentor and inspire junior team members, fostering a culture of learning, inclusion and high performance

Your skills

Must have

• At least 6 years' experience in audit within the commercial, industrial, public or related sectors
• Proven experience in a managerial role, leading teams and engagements
• In progress towards a Chartered Accountant qualification (IRE, DEC, IEC, ACCA or equivalent)
• Strong knowledge of audit methodologies and applicable standards; proven knowledge in PCOAB, IFRS and/or SOX is considered an asset
• Fluency in English and either French, German, Spanish, Italian or Portuguese

Nice to have

• Experience working with international or cross border clients
• Exposure to other reporting frameworks or regulatory environments

Soft skills

• Ability to build diverse capability within the team and support the development of others
• Strong collaboration skills, working effectively with colleagues and clients
• Focus on delivering value, with a solution oriented and agile mindset

IT skills

• Proficiency with standard audit and office tools (e.g. Excel, Word, PowerPoint)
• Experience with audit support tools and data analytics is considered an advantage
• Ability to quickly learn and adapt to new technologies and firm tools

Interested? Please submit your resume in English

Get to know more about Deloitte on our LinkedIn page (#DeloitteLU), Instagram page, YouTube page or website.

title: Solar Engineer, In-Orbit WPT Demo Mission (m/f/d)

Focus: You know that every ambitious space mission eventually comes down to "how much power do we really have?" and you're the person who enjoys making sure the answer is both accurate and impressive. As Solar Engineer, you'll own the solar cell and array side of TerraSpark's first space-to-Earth wireless power beaming demo. You'll be the in-house solar expert, responsible for the lightweight power generation system, how it bolts into the WPT payload and host spacecraft, and how it scales into future SBSP concepts.

What you'll do:

• Own the solar power generation concept for the in-orbit demo payload: pick the cells, size the array, and keep the power budget honest when everyone else is getting optimistic.

What you bring:

• MSc or BSc in a relevant engineering or physics discipline, with several years of experience inspace solar cell and array design and development.
• A proven track record on advanced lightweight solar arrays or high-specific-power panelconcepts, ideally including at least one project that actually flew rather than just looked heroicin CAD.
• Strong understanding of space solar cell and array technologies, with experience in siliconand/or perovskite as a clear asset, plus familiarity with radiation and degradation effects andhow they ruin optimistic plots.
• Experience on solar array projects where low-cost and low-mass were the main designdrivers, and at least a passing respect for manufacturability and supply-chain reality.
• Extensive hands-on experience with panel/module hardware, and a genuine enjoyment ofbuild-test-iterate workflows and rapid prototyping in a hardware-rich environment.
• Experience with the mechanical and thermal realities of solar panels and the ability to workconstructively with structures and thermal engineers rather than just sending them harderrequirements.
• Comfort with the electrical side of arrays (stringing, limits, interfaces to power conditioning),plus a basic grasp of SBSP concepts and how your array choices affect the grand plan, andthe ability to work smoothly with systems, WPT, RF electronics, thermal, and structurescolleagues.

title: Telecom Lead (m/f)
description:
Telecom Lead

Role Summary

The Telecom Lead is responsible for leading and growing OQ Technology's telecom engineering team and for the technical direction of the end-to-end telecommunication system that underpins the Company's 3GPP-based 4G/5G Non-Terrestrial Network (NTN). The role brings together the Core Network, physical-layer/DSP, and protocol-stack disciplines into a single, coherent engineering roadmap, and holds ultimate accountability for the architecture, quality, and delivery of the telecommunication stack from research and prototyping through to operational deployment on the Company's satellite missions.

The Telecom Lead manages the Senior Core Network Engineer, Core Network Engineer, DSP Algorithm Engineer, Telecom Engineer, and any other engineers assigned to the telecom function, setting priorities, allocating work, developing technical talent, and acting as the primary point of technical and people- management accountability for the team. The Company may assign the Employee to any other job or tasks if it believes it is in its best interests to do so.

Key Responsibilities

The list below is representative and not exhaustive of the tasks and responsibilities of the role.

• Lead, manage, and grow the telecom engineering team, providing day-to-day direction, coaching, and performance management.
• Plan resourcing and recruitment for the team, define roles and career paths, and build the technical bench
strength required to deliver the Company's telecommunication roadmap.
• Foster a collaborative, high-performance engineering culture across the core network, DSP/physical layer, and protocol-stack disciplines, and ensure effective knowledge-sharing between them.
• Own the technical onboarding of new engineers and ensure consistent engineering standards, coding practices, and design-review discipline across the team.

Technical Ownership and Architecture

• Hold overall technical authority for the architecture and evolution of OQ Technology's telecommunication
system, spanning the Core Network, the physical layer/DSP chain, and the NB-IoT/LTE/NR protocol stack adapted for NTN.
• Define the technical roadmap and research strategy for new functions, algorithms, and system architectures for 4G/5G communication over Non-Terrestrial Networks, and align it with the Company's product and mission timelines.
• Review and approve system-level designs, ensuring consistency and interoperability across core network, baseband/DSP, and protocol-stack workstreams, and across the space, ground, and user segments.
• Set and enforce engineering standards, design-review practices, and quality gates for networking architectures and control algorithms against latency, high-availability, and Quality of Experience requirements, from prototype through operational deployment.
• Own system performance models and lead cross-functional systems-engineering activities related to end-to end system performance optimisation.
• Guide the design and implementation of microservices-based, real-time and near real-time applications, and of DSP algorithms and baseband processing for the telecommunication payload and user terminals.
• Oversee the development, optimisation, and continuous upgrade of the protocol stack(s) supporting current and future missions, ensuring features are delivered against space and product team requirements.
• Approve subsystem budgets and specifications, and confirm regulatory and mission compliance in coordination with the systems engineering team.

Delivery, Testing, and Operations

• Direct the full development lifecycle across the team, from concept, prototyping, and proof-of-concept experimentation through implementation, verification, integration, and deployment.
• Ensure rigorous validation of telecommunication software and hardware features through simulation, lab testing, and end-to-end testing in simulated NTN environments.
• Oversee the maintenance, upgrade, and improvement of the internal telecommunications and RF lab, and ensure appropriate configuration control and version management of all deliverables.
• Support the space team with authoritative technical inputs for the design, optimisation, and maintenance of Operational and Demo Missions, including mission needs, expected performance, dependability, and safety goals.
• Own the resolution of escalations and cross-team technical blockers, and ensure timely, transparent reporting of progress and risks to senior management.

Stakeholder, Partner, and Standards Engagement

• Lead technical discussions and negotiations with external suppliers, MNO/MVNO partners, contractors, and research institutes, including evaluation of designs and acceptance of deliverables.
• Represent the Company in standardisation bodies and lead the Company's technical contributions to relevant standardisation activities.
• Own or contribute to technical documentation for project reviews, including ESA-related deliverables, and defend designs at formal project and customer reviews.
• Work with and support teams across OQ Subsidiaries and manage technical interfaces with external partners and contracting organisations.

Planning and Reporting

• Participate in project management and planning activities, including proposals, roadmaps, budgets, and resourcing for the telecom engineering function.
• Provide regular reporting on team progress, technical risks, and delivery status to the Head of Engineering / CTO and other stakeholders.
• Ensure proper documentation of all technology development undertaken by the team and maintain traceability for audits and project reviews.

Requirements

Education

• Master's degree (or higher) in Telecommunications Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field. A PhD is a plus.

Experience

• Significant professional experience (typically 8+ years) in telecommunications engineering, spanning at least two of the following domains: core network (EPC/5GC), physical layer/DSP, or protocol stack development.
• Proven experience leading or mentoring engineering teams, including performance management, technical coaching, and resource planning.
• Hands-on experience with 3GPP-based 4G/5G systems; experience with Non-Terrestrial Networks (NTN) or satellite communications is highly desirable.
• Experience engaging with standardisation bodies (3GPP, GSMA, ITU) and managing relationships with external suppliers, MNO/MVNO partners, or research institutes.
• Track record of taking systems from research/prototype through to operational deployment, including verification and validation in lab and field environments.

Technical Skills

• Strong knowledge of Core Network architecture and functions (MME, SPGW, HSS, OAM, IREG, IPX, BCE) and of NFV/microservices-based network applications.
• Solid understanding of physical-layer and DSP concepts (modem design, baseband processing, transceiver architecture) and of the NB-IoT/LTE/NR protocol stack.
• Proficiency with relevant development and simulation tools (e.g. C/C++, MATLAB, VHDL) and with CI/CD and version-control tools (e.g. Git).
• Familiarity with systems-engineering practices, including requirements derivation, performance modelling,and subsystem budgeting (e.g. RF link and power budgets).

Leadership and Personal Skills

• Excellent leadership, coaching, and people-management skills, with the ability to develop technical talent and build a high-performing team.
• Strong stakeholder-management and communication skills, able to engage effectively with senior management, external partners, and standardisation bodies.
• Strong organisational and prioritisation skills, able to balance strategic technical direction with hands-on problem-solving when required.
• Fluent in English (written and spoken); additional languages are a plus.
• Willingness to travel occasionally for partner, supplier, or standardisation meetings

MI & Investor Reporting

FP&A Systems, Data & analytics

• Own the FP&A systems and toolset, ensuring data is well-controlled, models are scalable, and that new data sources are integrated in a structured and controlled way.

• Comfortable with driving finance systems & finance process efficiency. You will identify and drive positive change to system structures and related processes which will support FP&A in raising our level.
• Experienced in driving automation in financial processes, and curious about the deployment of AI tooling to support efficiencies or deeper insights.
• Drive standardisation across the team in how we aggregate and analyse large data sets, reducing reliance on fragmented individual processes and moving to consistent, repeatable approaches.
• Coordinate the wider FP&A team to engage with Financial Control with the goal of addressing potential General Ledger integrity issues or identifying improvements to ERP data entry to enhance reporting.
• Work with relevant departments to gather client revenue and cost of sales data for analytical purposes, building reliable data flows that FP&A can depend on.

Budgeting & Forecasting

• Partner across FP&A and broader Finance function to co-ordinate the annual budget process for revenue and cost of sales, ensuring alignment of inputs and consistent methodology.

• Build and maintain strong working relationships with all key internal and external stakeholders, including investors and senior leadership.

Team Leadership

• Continuously evolve how the team measures and presents performance, always seeking to increase the actionable impact of the analysis.
• Raise the bar on presentation quality across the team, ensuring all outputs - whether for internal leadership or external investors — are executive-ready.

• 10+ years post-qualified finance experience, with a meaningful proportion in FP&A or financial reporting in a complex, multi-entity environment.

Desirable

Your area of work:

As Business Resilience Officer, you will be part of the Clearstream Securities Services (CSS) Business Resilience function within the Independent Business Risk and Control (IBRC) area, supporting the governance of first line of defence (1LoD) risk and control practices, with a focus on strengthening the effectiveness, quality and efficiency of the internal control environment.

In this role, you will support the team in connecting processes, risks, controls, findings, incidents, claims and remediation activities into a single risk-resilience cycle. You will contribute to a robust, proportionate and fit-for-purpose Internal Control System (ICS), while building your analytical skills and progressively adopting data, automation and Artificial Intelligence (AI) capabilities under the guidance of more experienced colleagues.

Your responsibilities:

• Support ICS quality and efficiency: Perform analysis on the quality, adequacy, completeness and consistency of CSS processes, risks and controls, and support continuous improvements towards proportionate, balanced and efficient ICS key controls.
• Support audit and supervisory remediation: Assist in the coordination of regulatory onsite inspections and in the tracking of significant internal, statutory and regulatory findings, including support to evidence collection, Corrective Action Plan (CAP) documentation and remediation progress monitoring.
• Assist external assurance coordination: Support ISAE 3402 and SOC 2 audit work, including preparation of documentation, drafting of observations, follow-up on improvement measures and liaison with the external auditor under the supervision of more senior team members.
• Contribute to integrated control reporting: Support connecting-the-dots analysis and reporting across internal and external findings, Self-Identified Issues (SII), claims and goodwill, and incidents, helping to provide a comprehensive view of control maturity, failure events and actionable remediation; contribute to the Annual Management Report on Internal Controls.
• Support SII and CAP lifecycle management: Assist in the identification of SIIs and associated CAPs, help maintain the inventory, monitor remediation progress and support transparent reporting.
• Contribute to the risk-resilience cycle: Support the integration, rationalisation and elevation of the risk-resilience cycle by helping to challenge business practices and supporting the simplification and automation of processes, including the adoption of AI tools and techniques.

Your profile:

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Management, Banking, Finance or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
• 1-3 years of relevant professional experience in the financial services industry is preferred, ideally within banks, financial market infrastructures, regulatory bodies or supervisory authorities. A basic understanding of the Three Lines of Defense (3LoD) model and first line of defense (1LoD) risk and control responsibilities is expected.
• Initial exposure to or keen interest in at least one of the activities listed under your responsibilities, such as ICS quality, operational risk and controls, audit or supervisory remediation, external assurance, SII and CAP management, integrated control reporting, incidents, claims or resilience-related governance. Prior internship or traineeship experience in a related area is a plus.
• Ability to perform structured analysis, produce clear and accurate deliverables, follow up on tasks reliably and seek guidance proactively. Willingness to learn, ask questions and accept constructive feedback.
• Good written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to summarise information clearly and contribute to the preparation of materials for management review.
• Analytical mindset with attention to detail, curiosity, pragmatism and a willingness to work in a fast-paced environment where priorities may shift. A structured approach to problem-solving is valued.
• Good command of Microsoft Excel, familiarity with SharePoint and collaborative document management, ability to prepare clear presentations, and openness to learning and using AI-based tools and automation in daily work.
• Fluency in spoken and written English is required; German and French are an advantage.

title: Kapitän (m/f)
description:
Description des tâches:


Chemgas Barging S.à r.l., Luxembourg
Inland shipping


Transporting gas on inland waterways in an efficient, reliable and safe manner. That is what we do and what we are good at. Chemgas is the market leader in the transport of pressurized liquefied gases on inland waterways. Our colleagues are committed to this 24/7, all year round. You too can contribute to this! We are looking for a captain for our inland shipping fleet.


What will you do?

As a captain, you provide motivating leadership and this enables you to ensure that our crew and the ship function optimally. You know how to guide your colleagues in the right way, ensure the pleasant working atmosphere on board and promote growth. In the position of captain, you are responsible for the safe, optimal and proper execution of the transport. You carry out your work within the framework of our ship policy and, where necessary, you contribute to improvements. In addition, safety is of paramount importance to you. You help ensure that all (safety) protocols and guidelines on board are complied with.


What ambition do you contribute to?

Chemgas is not standing still, and neither is our inland shipping branch. Our modern and well-maintained fleet is always evolving. We invest a lot of time and energy in new construction and conversion projects. In recent years, our fleet has been expanded with a number of new ships. New construction projects are also planned for the coming years and we are once again rejuvenating our inland shipping fleet. As a result, we are looking for additional talent to strengthen our team.

Partly because of our innovative ships, we strive for the highest achievable. Efficient gas transport for our clients is central and our employees are paramount. With your expertise, you can make an important contribution to this objective.


Are you looking after the vacancy?

You have an eye for safety, the environment and health and you also like to work in a team.


We also ask the following:

You are in possession of a Rhine patent up to at least Mannheim and you can also sail this route independently;
You are willing to obtain your patent up to Iffezheim;
ADN base and willingness to obtain ADN gas;
Radar patent;
VHF certificate;
EU Qualification Certificate.

What do we offer?

Is sailing on the wide rivers and canals in your blood? Are you also looking for a versatile job in inland shipping? Then Chemgas offers you many opportunities for a challenging career. Our inland vessels operate from Amsterdam-Rotterdam-Antwerp to Basel. We invest a lot in our employees and our ships. Our fleet is always evolving and equipped according to the latest techniques and innovations. Thanks in part to our motivated crew, there is a positive and enthusiastic atmosphere on board our ships. Expertise, dedication and discipline are paramount. On our inland shipping fleet, we only sail with Dutch-speaking colleagues. Chemgas is a committed company where a lot is possible and your work is appreciated. We focus on internal growth and therefore invest a lot of time in good training and advancement opportunities.

Our barge fleet operates from Luxembourg. Our sailing leave schedule consists of one week on board and one week at home, but two weeks on and two weeks off is also possible. On board you walk in a system of 8 hours on/8 hours. On an annual basis, you have the choice to work 24/28, 25/27 or 26/26 weeks. Would you like to know more about our terms of employment or do you have questions about this? Do not hesitate to contact us and we will be happy to help you!

title: Finance Manager, EU AMXL (m/f)
description:
Finance Manager, EU AMXL
Job ID: 10507726 | Amazon EU Sarl

Description

The EU AMXL Finance team is looking for a Finance Manager to own the financial strategy and controllership within the AMXL Fulfillment space. Amazon Extra Large (AMXL) manages the end-to-end fulfillment of heavy and bulky products — a strategic, high-growth segment for Amazon in Europe, operating across multiple countries with diverse operational and legal frameworks.

This is a senior individual contributor role for a finance leader who can operate with a high degree of autonomy, influence senior stakeholders, and shape decisions that affect the long-term economics of the EU AMXL network. The successful candidate will own financial planning and controllership for their area end-to-end, partner directly with Director-level operations and network leaders, and drive strategic analyses that inform multi-year network topology, rate, and investment decisions. They will be expected to challenge assumptions with data, build mechanisms that scale, and bring clarity to ambiguous, complex problems.

Key job responsibilities

Strategic Finance & Decision Support:

- Own the financial plan (OP1/OP2/QxG) and long-range outlook for your area, independently building models and scenarios that inform network strategy.
- Lead high-impact analyses (e.g., network topology, rate setting, cost-to-serve, business cases) and present recommendations directly to senior leadership.
- Challenge operational and business partner assumptions with data, providing disruptive ideas where the numbers warrant it.

Business Partnering & Influence:

- Act as the trusted finance partner to Director-level operations, planning, and network leaders, influencing strategic decisions without direct authority.
- Navigate across organizations (e.g., Network, Transportation, Supply Chain, Accounting, Procurement) to align stakeholders and drive outcomes.
- Translate complex financial trade-offs into clear narratives for both Finance and non-Finance senior audiences.

Controllership & Operational Excellence:

- Own financial reporting integrity for your area (month-end close, variance analysis, cost controls), routinely delivering error-free outputs.
- Proactively identify control gaps and risks driven by business, regulatory, or operational change, and design solutions.
- Invent and institutionalize mechanisms (dashboards, automated reporting, planning tools) that scale across the team and network.

Leadership & Force Multiplication:

- Mentor and coach junior analysts, raising the bar on analytical rigor across the team.
- Contribute to the broader Finance community through best-practice sharing, hiring, and development initiatives.
- Identify and drive process improvements that remove bottlenecks and improve decision-making speed across the org.

A day in the life

No two days look the same in AMXL Finance. You might start the morning partnering with an operations leader to pressure-test a network change, spend mid-morning deep in a cost-to-serve model that will shape next year's topology, then present your findings to senior leadership in the afternoon. You'll move fluidly between the detail (validating a cost driver, reconciling a variance) and the big picture (where should we invest, what's the long-term economic story). You'll be the financial voice in the room — challenging assumptions, surfacing risks early, and helping the business make smarter, faster decisions. Expect autonomy, real ownership, and the space to build mechanisms that outlast any single planning cycle.

About the team

We are the EU AMXL Inbound & Middle Mile Finance team — a small, high-trust group of finance professionals supporting one of Amazon's fastest-growing and most operationally complex segments. We own the financials for how heavy and bulky products move through the European network, from inbound and cross-dock through to middle mile transportation. We work closely with operations, planning, and network teams across multiple countries, and we pride ourselves on combining analytical rigor with genuine business partnership. We care about developing our people, learning continuously, and making the work both impactful and enjoyable.

- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Mathematics, Economics, or another relevant field
- Experience in a finance role including partnering with a variety of stakeholders across the business
- Experience working with Excel and large-scale data mining and reporting tools such as Python, SQL, or Tableau
- Experience in financial modeling

- Experience working in large teams or at a national/multinational organization

Amazon's culture encourages an entrepreneurial approach and expects engineers and managers alike to take a high level of ownership in solving complex problems in a fast-paced environment.

- Develop vendor qualification protocols and contracts and representing Amazon in meetings with senior executive teams from top selling partners.
- Establish goals & strategic direction for the role, ensuring alignment with broader business goals and vision. This includes goals around cost reductions and improved quality and safety processes.

Description

You will join a team which:

Amazon is committed to building a sustainable future for our customers, local communities, and the planet. Under The Climate Pledge, we committed to achieving net-zero carbon across our business by 2040, ten years ahead of the Paris Agreement. description:
Process Improvement Specialist, GOX - Ops Excellence
Job ID: 10503194 | Amazon EU Sarl

Description

At Amazon we believe that every day is still day one. A day to take the first step, look forward to new challenges, and make your ideas come to life. That's the energy and passion behind Amazon, and today is your day to be part of it.

The Process Improvement Specialist in Global Operational Excellence (GOX) owns the expansion of proven EU Operational Excellence solutions into new Amazon regions. You sit within the EU organisation and work hand in hand with regional Operations teams. You are the bridge that takes tools, mechanisms and data-driven solutions already delivering results in the EU, then adapts, extends and rolls them out across a new network.

Your core loop is straightforward: understand what the region needs, partner with technology teams to expand the solution to meet that need, then support the local ACES team in rolling it out on the ground. You will listen to operators and leaders to surface real problems, translate those needs into clear requirements for tech partners, and enable local teams to adopt the solution and sustain it without constant central support. Stakeholder management is the largest part of this job.

Analytics is the backbone. You will mine and interpret large-scale operational datasets to find where a region's gaps are, quantify the opportunity behind each solution, and validate through rigorous pre and post analysis that expanded tools actually move the metrics that matter. You will write SQL against large data warehouses (Andes/Redshift, Athena) and use visualisation tools (QuickSight, Tableau, Power BI) to make insights self-service for stakeholders, connecting systemic root causes to shop-floor impact and customer delivery outcomes. You are not expected to own production data engineering, but you should be comfortable pulling, transforming and analysing data independently, framing operational challenges as structured analytical problems, and holding deep technical conversations with engineering and analytics partners.

We are looking for a process improvement leader who enjoys operational analytics and cross-region collaboration, and who can turn a good idea in one geography into a scaled, sustained, data-backed capability in another. You want to find out what a region does not know yet, equip its stakeholders and ACES teams with the right solutions, and make adoption last beyond launch.

Please note: this role is based in the EU and can be located at any EU node. It requires up to 35% travel, primarily within the EU, with occasional travel to partner regions to support rollouts and stakeholder engagement.

Key job responsibilities

- Act as the primary bridge between EU GOX solutions and regional Operations teams, owning the end-to-end expansion of EU tools and mechanisms into a new network.
- Engage deeply with regional Ops stakeholders at all levels to understand their needs, pain points and priorities, and translate them into a clear, data-backed solution roadmap.
- Perform data mining and analysis across multiple systems (Redshift, Athena and other warehouses) to identify the region's gaps, quantify the opportunity, and prioritize which EU solutions to expand.
- Write advanced SQL (window functions, CTEs, query optimization) to perform root cause analysis and connect systemic issues to shop-floor and customer delivery impact.
- Build and maintain dashboards and self-service analytical tools (QuickSight, automated reports) that let regional stakeholders detect problems ahead of customer impact.
- Develop assessments, readouts and reports that communicate rollout progress, adoption and quantified business impact to regional and EU senior leadership.
- Identify and manage the risks, dependencies and cross-region differences (regulatory, network, systems) that affect successful adoption.
- Build a repeatable, data-backed playbook for expanding EU solutions into new regions that scales to additional workstreams over time.

About the team

The Global Operational Excellence (GOX) team drives operational improvements across Amazon's EU fulfillment network and beyond, working at the intersection of technology and operations to optimize how inventory is placed, moved and delivered. GOX builds the standards, tools and daily management mechanisms that turn performance into a managed system rather than a daily fire-fight. This role extends solutions proven in the EU into new regions, equipping local Operations teams to deliver flawless fulfillment: on time, at speed and at the lowest cost.

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or above in engineering, project management, operations, logistics, supply chain or related field
- Experience in program or project management, delivering initiatives from concept to execution.
- Experience with reporting and data visualization tools such as QuickSight, Tableau, Power BI, or other BI packages.
- Experience working cross-functionally with both technical and non-technical teams, including operations.
- Experience working with operations and business teams to communicate problem impacts and understand business requirements.
- Experience with hands-on SQL coding and working with large, complex data sets to design models and scenarios.
- Experience communicating and influencing stakeholders at all levels, including presenting complex, data-backed recommendations to senior leadership.

Preferred Qualifications

- Master's degree in supply chain management, operations, engineering, analytics, or a related field.
- Experience in operations, transportation, or supply chain.
- Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to drive improvements.
- Experience rolling out tools, processes, or mechanisms across multiple sites or regions.
- Experience with data warehouse architectures, data modeling, ETL/ELT, and analytic tools and environments.
- Experience with AWS technologies such as Redshift, S3, Athena, AWS Glue, EMR, Lambda, and IAM.
- Python programming experience for data manipulation (pandas, numpy) and basic statistical analysis.
- Experience partnering with technology teams to translate business needs into system requirements and new features.

title: Financial Crime Prevention Analyst / Investigator (m/f)
description:
Financial Crime Prevention Analyst / Investigator (M/F)
Luxembourg
req1145

BIL is a leading player in Luxembourg's financial market. Founded in 1856 as the country's first bank, BIL has contributed significantly to the development of Luxembourg's social and economic landscape. Today, BIL operates across digital banking, wealth management and corporate finance, supporting individuals, entrepreneurs, businesses, and both private and institutional investors. Headquartered in Luxembourg, BIL employs more than 1,800 people and maintains a presence in key financial centers including Luxembourg, Switzerland, France and China. As a major player in Luxembourg's finance industry and as a signatory of the UN Principles of Responsible Banking, BIL is committed to handing over a responsible and sustainable bank to future generations.

One of the key missions of the Financial Crime Prevention (FCP) function is to conduct independent and risk-based investigations to protect the Bank's assets, reputation, and integrity, while ensuring compliance with Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing (AML/CFT) regulatory requirements.

As a Financial Crime Prevention Analyst, you will play a pivotal role in the detection, assessment, and investigation of potential financial crime risks. This position requires strong regulatory knowledge, excellent interpersonal skills, a genuine investigative mindset, and the ability to navigate complex situations involving AML/CFT, reputational, tax, and other financial crime-related risks.

Your next challenge:

• Review, assess, and investigate cases involving potentially suspicious activity and financial crime concerns.
• Conduct enhanced due diligence, background checks, adverse media reviews, and open-source intelligence research on prospects, clients, counterparties, and transactional parties.
• Analyze customer profiles, account activity, transaction flows, corporate structures, and supporting documentation to identify red flags and assess potential risks.
• Document, structure, and synthesize investigative findings, presenting well-supported assessment to the Compliance Incident Committee (CIC).
• Gather and compile all relevant information required for the preparation and submission of Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) to the Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU).
• Draft high-quality SARs/STRs based on comprehensive assessments of client activity, transactional behavior, and overall risk exposure.
• Act as a key liaison with the FIU and support responses to regulatory inquiries and requests.
• Collaborate closely with Compliance, Front Office, Credit, Operations, Legal, and other stakeholders to support investigations and manage financial crime risks.
• Keep abreast of evolving financial crime typologies, regulatory developments, and industry best practices.

Your skills:

• 3 to 5 years of relevant experience in Financial Crime Compliance, AML/CFT Investigations, Compliance, Risk Management, or a related field.
• Proven experience dealing with financial crime matters, suspicious activity investigations, and high-risk client relationships.
• Strong understanding of AML/CFT regulations, financial crime typologies, and investigative methodologies.
• Knowledge of banking activities, legal structures, financial products, and client relationships is considered a strong asset.
• Previous experience in Front Office, Credit, Client Relationship Management, or other banking functions would be highly valued.
• Fluency in English and French is mandatory.
• Knowledge of any additional European language would be considered an asset.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.
• Strong investigative mindset with a genuine interest in conducting research and uncovering complex financial crime patterns.
• Excellent analytical and critical thinking skills with the ability to connect information from multiple sources and formulate reasoned conclusions.
• Strong synthesis and report-writing abilities.
• Curiosity, resilience, sound judgment, and the confidence to challenge when required.
• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Ability to work autonomously while also contributing effectively within a team environment.
• Highly organized, proactive, and capable of managing multiple priorities under pressure.
• Detail-oriented with a strong sense of integrity, discretion, and accountability.

BIL offers a broad range of challenging projects and a huge choice of career paths .We will assist you in finding the one that best meets your skills and expectations. Your personal development is our priority and we greatly encourage you to dive into different business areas for the broadest possible experience.

BIL is firmly of the opinion that diversity & inclusion contribute towards increasing the collective performance of the Bank. We are committed to creating a culture of inclusion that encourages individual development with equal opportunities for all.

NB: The selected candidate will be asked to provide an extract from the criminal record (no.3) as evidence of integrity and justified with regard to the specific needs of the position to be filled. Other documents will be collected, to the extent legally permitted, to perform background checks.

title: International Tax Senior Advisor (m/f)
description:
International Tax Senior Advisor
Locations Luxembourg
Time type Full time
Job requisition id JR100208

Operating as an internationally integrated partnership in over 100 countries and territories, Forvis Mazars Group specialises in audit, tax and advisory services. The partnership draws on the expertise and cultural understanding of over 40,000 professionals across the globe to assist clients of all sizes at every stage in their development.

Joining our team as a Senior Tax Advisor means taking on a pivotal role within a dynamic and fast-paced advisory environment, where technical excellence and high-quality client service are at the core of everything we do.

You will operate in a stimulating and demanding consulting environment where excellence, ownership and continuous development are expected.

You will lead complex assignments aligned with our clients' strategic priorities, bringing technical expertise and a pragmatic approach to problem-solving. As a key point of contact for both clients and junior team members, you will contribute to high-quality deliverables while ensuring deadlines and expectations are consistently met.

You will play an active role in client interactions, developing strong relationships, understanding their challenges and providing tailored, value-added advice. Beyond client work, you will play an important role in the development of our team. You will coach and mentor junior team members, review their work and contribute to fostering a collaborative and high-performing culture. Your experience and leadership will help shape both individual careers and the continued growth of our practice.

In return, we offer a stimulating and intellectually challenging environment that encourages initiative and provides genuine opportunities for career progression. Through ongoing training, exposure to complex international projects and increasing leadership responsibilities, you will be empowered to continuously develop your expertise and advance your professional ambitions.

Responsibilities:

As part of our International Tax team, you will take on a central role in delivering high-quality advisory services within a dynamic and client-driven environment.

Your role will include:

• Advising clients on complex International and Luxembourg tax matters, ensuring technical accuracy and relevance in a constantly evolving regulatory landscape;
• Leading and reviewing in-depth tax analysis, and translating technical findings into clear, strategic and actionable recommendations;
• Managing client engagements, including planning, execution and timely delivery of high-quality outputs;
• Acting as a potential point of contact for clients, starting building trusted relationships with the aim of ensuring  full client satisfaction;
• Supervising, mentoring and reviewing the work of junior team members, fostering their development and ensuring quality standards;
• Contributing indirectly to business development initiatives, including proposals and pitches with the support of a highly experienced advisory team ;
• Collaborating closely with  your management team and actively contributing to the growth and positioning of your service line.
You will be expected to demonstrate high dedication to work, a high level of rigor in all aspects of your work and substantial capacity to share your knowledge with your team members.

Your Profile:

• Master's degree in Economics, Finance, Accounting or Law (with a specialization in Tax Law);
• 2–4 years of relevant experience in International Tax, preferably within a consulting or professional services firm;
• Strong technical expertise in International and Luxembourg tax frameworks;
• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure and simplify complex matters;
• Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver under pressure;
• Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with first experiences in client interactions;
• Demonstrated ability to supervise and coach junior team members;
• Proactive, results-driven and committed to continuous learning and professional growth;
• Fluent in French and English (written and spoken).

What We Offer

• A high-impact role with increased autonomy, responsibility and potential client exposure depending on your skills and behavior;
• A key learning process over the long term in business developments initiatives;
• The opportunity to work on complex, technical and strategic assignments;
• A clear career path with leadership development opportunities;
• Continuous learning tailored to your level of experience and ambitions;
• A human-sized international group combining proximity, entrepreneurial spirit and global reach;
• A dynamic, collaborative and high-performing environment where excellence and teamwork go hand in hand.

Forvis Mazars is an equal opportunities employer and is committed to building a diverse and inclusive culture in which each individual feels welcomed.

We consider candidates based on their skills, abilities or experiences as we believe everyone brings their own talents with them.
The diversity of our talents is what makes our work environment multicultural, innovative and enriching.

Du hjælper med teknisk support, guider kunder gennem platformen og sørger for, at eventuelle problemer bliver løst hurtigt og korrekt. Du overvåger også hjemmesidens funktionalitet og rapporterer fejl eller driftsproblemer til teamlederen. Derudover hjælper du med at promovere nye produkter og kampagner og støtter teamet i ad hoc-opgaver, når der er behov.

Du bliver en del af et mindre, socialt team, hvor personlighed og samarbejde vægtes højt — og hvor fredagsbar, fælles frokost og sociale aktiviteter er en naturlig del af kulturen.

Bidrager til teamet og udviklingen

Du er med til at skabe en god stemning i teamet og bidrager til, at hverdagen fungerer. Du deler viden, støtter nye kolleger og hjælper med at sikre, at teamet arbejder effektivt og med høj kvalitet. Da teamet er lille, har du mulighed for hurtigt at få mere ansvar og udvikle dig i rollen. Du bliver en vigtig del af et fællesskab, hvor man hjælper hinanden, og hvor personlighed og teamfit er afgørende.

Dit ansvar:

  • Kundesupport via e-mail og chat

  • Teknisk vejledning og fejlfinding

  • Overvågning af platformens funktionalitet

  • Rapportering af driftsproblemer

  • Hjælp til kampagner og produktinformation

Dine kvalifikationer:

  • Udadvendt, social og trives i et ungt team

  • Har øje for detaljer og arbejder struktureret

  • Motiveret for at lære — erfaring er ikke et krav

  • Bonus: Erfaring med kundeservice eller kendskab til casino-/iGaming-branchen

  • Evne til at håndtere flere opgaver og bevare overblikket

Da teamet kun består af otte danske kolleger, lægger man stor vægt på personlighed og på, hvordan du fungerer i fællesskabet. Du skal trives i et miljø, hvor man både arbejder sammen og laver ting sammen uden for arbejdstiden.

Løn og benefits:

  • Relocationpakke

Karrieremæssige fordele:

  • Internationale muligheder – Malta er et globalt knudepunkt for tech- og iGaming-industrien, hvilket giver adgang til et bredt netværk af virksomheder og karrieremuligheder.

  • Erhvervserfaring i et voksende marked, en vigtig del af den digitale verden, og erfaring inden for dette felt kan åbne døre til fremtidige roller i tech, compliance og kundeservice.

  • Udvikling af værdifulde færdigheder – Du vil opbygge kompetencer inden for kommunikation, problemløsning og digital sikkerhed, som er eftertragtede på arbejdsmarkedet.

  • Mulighed for karrierevækst – Mange virksomheder i Malta tilbyder interne udviklingsprogrammer og karriereforløb, så du kan avancere i din rolle.

Livet på Malta:

  • Middelhavslivsstil – Malta byder på en afslappet livsstil med smukke strande, historiske byer og en livlig expat-community.

  • Engelsk som arbejdssprog – Engelsk er et af de officielle sprog i Malta, hvilket gør det nemt at integrere sig både socialt og professionelt.

  • Lav kriminalitet og god sikkerhed – Malta har en af de laveste kriminalitetsrater i Europa, hvilket gør det til et trygt sted at bo.

  • Leveomkostninger – Leveomkostningerne er generelt lavere end i mange andre europæiske lande, især når det kommer til bolig og dagligvarer.

Skat på Malta:

  • Attraktive skatteforhold – Malta har en gunstig skattepolitik for expats, hvor indkomstskat kan være så lav som 15 % for visse erhvervsgrupper.

  • Ingen ejendomsskat – Der er ingen årlig ejendomsskat, hvilket kan være en fordel for dem, der ønsker at investere i bolig.

  • Lav selskabsskat – Hvis du senere ønsker at starte din egen virksomhed, har Malta en af de mest konkurrencedygtige skatteordninger i EU.

Klimaet på Malta:

  • Solrigt året rundt – Malta har over 300 solskinsdage om året, hvilket gør det til et af de mest solrige steder i Europa.

  • Milde vintre – Selv i januar falder temperaturen sjældent under 10°C, hvilket betyder, at du kan nyde udendørslivet året rundt.

  • Varme somre – Sommeren kan blive varm med temperaturer op til 35°C, men den friske havbrise gør det behageligt.

title: Legal & Compliance Manager (B2B) - Malta
description:
Come and join our journey!

A taste of what you’ll do

As a Legal & Compliance Manager (B2B), you will serve as a primary legal and compliance contact for business-to-business affairs, supporting a broad range of contractual, regulatory, and gambling compliance responsibilities across multiple jurisdictions.

Accountabilities:

    Act as a primary legal partner for B2B affairs, leading day-to-day contractual reviews, negotiations, and drafting of a broad range of commercial agreements and related documentation.
    Lead the preparation, review, and negotiation of commercial contracts using and refining standard templates, including platform and content supply, software licensing, distribution, and reseller arrangements.
    Provide clear, commercially focused legal advice to management, presenting legal risks, practical options, and strategic recommendations to support informed decision-making.
    Collaborate cross-functionally with the broader Group legal and compliance function to support business objectives.
    Manage the preparation, submission, and ongoing maintenance of gaming licence applications across multiple jurisdictions, taking ownership of assigned portfolios.
    Verify that prospective and existing B2B clients hold valid gambling licences or authorisations in each market in which products or services will be deployed, and monitor counterparty licence status, regulatory standing, and market exits throughout the relationship lifecycle.
    Maintain the approved-markets framework, advising on market permissibility and regulated versus unregulated market positioning, and ensuring territory and geo-restriction requirements are reflected in commercial agreements.
    Support proactive and collaborative relationships with regulatory authorities, as needed.
    Manage ongoing licence maintenance obligations across the B2B licence portfolio, including key event reporting, regulatory notifications, periodic returns, and compliance and system audits.
    Act as holder of key functions and/or personal management licences, as applicable, across relevant jurisdictions, subject to regulatory approval and applicable vetting requirements.
    Monitor regulatory developments affecting B2B supply, assessing the impact of new and emerging supplier licensing regimes and feeding outcomes into market entry, certification, and licensing strategies.
    Create, update, implement, monitor, and enforce policies, procedures, guidelines, and manuals.
    Oversee technical compliance requirements, including managing relationships with accredited test laboratories, owning the certification and homologation roadmap for each jurisdiction, and coordinating security audits and product certification.
    Manage regulatory change-management processes for game and platform releases, coordinating with product and technical teams on certification, notification, and remediation requirements.
    Ensure content and brand protection by registration, maintenance, and renewal of intellectual property rights by assisting in any IP disputes that may arise from time to time, and developing and implementing a domain name strategy.
    Own the B2B counterparty onboarding and due diligence framework, including Know Your Business (KYB) and Customer Due Diligence (CDD) on prospective clients and suppliers, sanctions and adverse media screening, and anti-bribery and corruption due diligence on commercial partners and intermediaries.
    Advise on data protection matters arising in B2B arrangements, including controller–processor analysis, negotiation of data processing agreements, and international data transfer requirements, in coordination with the Group’s data protection function.
    Perform other job-related functions as assigned.

Qualifications

    Qualified lawyer with a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Law (LLB or equivalent).

Required Skills

    1–3 years’ post-qualification experience in regulatory, legal, or advisory roles, within B2B iGaming.
    Demonstrated experience in multi-jurisdictional gambling regulation and licensing, including the preparation and management of licence applications and regulatory submissions.
    Demonstrated experience drafting and negotiating B2B commercial agreements, such as platform and content supply, software licensing, distribution, and reseller arrangements.
    Familiarity with B2B/supplier licensing and authorisation regimes, as distinct from operator licensing, and with technical compliance and certification frameworks, including working with accredited test laboratories.
    Eligibility and willingness to undergo regulatory vetting and to hold key function or personal management licence appointments, as required; prior experience holding such appointments is advantageous.
    Experience providing independent regulatory advice to internal business stakeholders.
    Working knowledge of data protection requirements in a B2B contracting context, including data processing agreements and international transfers.
    Exposure to intellectual property portfolio management, brand protection, or counterparty due diligence (KYB/CDD, sanctions screening) is advantageous.

Preferred Skills

    Strong legal research, analysis, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and address regulatory issues independently.
    Sound commercial drafting and negotiation skills across a broad range of B2B agreement types.
    Ability to interpret complex regulatory requirements and translate them into clear, practical, and commercially sound advice.
    Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present regulatory analysis to non-legal audiences.
    Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage a varied and demanding workload, prioritise effectively, and meet deadlines.
    High level of professionalism, integrity, and attention to detail.
    Fluency in English is required; proficiency in an additional language is advantageous.

Employee benefits

    Wellness allowance – up to €300 per year
    Fresh and healthy breakfast & lunch prepared daily in our penthouse kitchen

description:

Long-Term Growth: Start with flexible hours (24 to 40 hours per week) with the genuine potential to convert into a permanent contract as the company grows.

Je beheert en ontwikkelt bestaande strategische relaties, maar kijkt tegelijkertijd actief vooruit. Welke infrastructuurprojecten komen eraan? Waar bevinden zich nieuwe opportuniteiten? Welke stakeholders moeten vroeg in het proces betrokken worden? En hoe kan Amiblu vanuit haar technische expertise een meerwaarde creëren?
Je positioneert jezelf daarbij als een inhoudelijke gesprekspartner voor de klant. Niet vanuit een puur transactionele verkoopbenadering, maar door technische uitdagingen te begrijpen, verschillende belangen met elkaar te verbinden en samen met de klant tot de meest geschikte oplossing te komen.
 
Je volgt opportuniteiten vanaf een vroege projectfase en blijft betrokken gedurende het commerciële traject.Jouw verantwoordelijkhedenBinnen deze rol:
  • neem je de commerciële ontwikkeling van Vlaanderen mee in handen;
  • bouw je duurzame relaties uit met overheden, watermaatschappijen, nutsbedrijven, studiebureaus, aannemers en andere relevante marktpartijen;
  • onderhoud en versterk je bestaande strategische klantenrelaties;
  • identificeer je nieuwe projecten, klanten en commerciële opportuniteiten;
  • adviseer je klanten en projectpartners over technische oplossingen en toepassingen;
  • analyseer je technische behoeften en vertaal je deze naar concrete, duurzame oplossingen;
  • volg je projecten reeds vanaf de ontwerp- en voorbereidingsfase;
  • voer je commerciële gesprekken en onderhandelingen met verschillende stakeholders;
  • volg je relevante marktontwikkelingen en innovaties binnen de Vlaamse infrastructuursector;
  • bouw je actief verder aan de marktpositie van Amiblu in België;
  • werk je nauw samen met de collega's van Amiblu Benelux in Tiel, zodat projecten van technisch advies tot realisatie professioneel worden ondersteund.

  • een bachelor- of masterdenkniveau, bij voorkeur binnen een technische richting zoals bouwkunde, civiele techniek of een vergelijkbare opleiding;
  • relevante ervaring binnen een technisch-commerciële B2B-omgeving;
  • het vermogen om technische vraagstukken te doorgronden én commercieel te vertalen;
  • ervaring met het ontwikkelen en onderhouden van professionele klantrelaties;
  • een proactieve en resultaatgerichte manier van werken;
  • sterke communicatieve en onderhandelingsvaardigheden;
  • voldoende autonomie om zelfstandig een markt en klantenportefeuille verder te ontwikkelen.
  • Een bestaand netwerk binnen de Vlaamse infrastructuur-, water- of rioleringssector is een duidelijke meerwaarde.
  • Je communiceert uitstekend in het Nederlands en Frans en kunt je professioneel uitdrukken in het Engels. Kennis van het Duits vormt een bijkomende troef.

description:
Haemme etätyöntekijöiksi vakituisia ilmoitusmyyjiä, jotka myyvät ilmoitustilaa eri järjestöjen lehtiin. Järjestölehtiä meillä on monelta eri alalta. Esimerkkeinä poliisin ja viranomaisten eri järjestöt, Opaskoirayhdistys, Sydänlapset ja monia muita. Kaiken kaikkiaan edustamme noin 50 eri yhdistystä.

Maksamme palkan kerran viikossa. Meillä voi työskennellä verokirjalla, kevytyrittäjänä ja omalla yrityksellä.

Tässä hieman tietoa järjestölehdistä:

https://www.yhdistyslehdet.fi https://printmixoyhelsinki.wordpress.com/

Et tarvitse alan aikaisempaa kokemusta, koulutamme tehtävään.

Odotamme sinulta myyntihenkisyyttä, ahkeruutta ja rehtiä suhtautumista työhön. Työ edellyttää hyvää suomen kielen taitoa. Aikaisempi kokemus puhelinmyyjä- ja telemarkkinointityöstä on eduksi.

Tarjoamme mukavan myytävän tuotteen, nykyaikaiset työkalut, ammattitaitoisen ja kannustavan työympäristön.

Kyseessä on päivätyö, jota voi tehdä 8.00–18.00 välisenä aikana arkisin.

Työtä voi suorittaa kokopäivätyönä tai osapäivätyönä.

Tarjoamme sinulle hyvän palkan ja hyvät puitteet työn suorittamiseen. Järjestämme säännöllisesti myös myyntikilpailuja, jotka antavat mukavaa virettä tekemiseen. Myyntipäällikkömme auttavat työntekemisessä koko ajan.

Arvostamme hyviä työntekijöitä, pidämme työntekijöistämme hyvän huolen.
