title: CNC-operatörer till RZ Ölme  svarvning och fräsning
description:
CNC-operatörer till RZ Ölme – svarvning och fräsning

RZ Ölme söker CNC-operatörer med inriktning mot svarvning eller fräsning. Vi växer och investerar i vår produktion och söker därför fler skickliga medarbetare som vill utvecklas tillsammans med oss.

Hos oss arbetar du med tillverkning av tekniskt krävande detaljer för kunder med höga krav inom flera olika industrisegment. Produktionen omfattar både återkommande serier och varierande arbeten i mindre volymer.

Om tjänsten

Som CNC-operatör ansvarar du, beroende på erfarenhet och vilken maskin du arbetar i, för hela eller delar av tillverkningsprocessen. I vissa maskiner ingår även programmering som en naturlig del av arbetet.

Arbetsuppgifterna omfattar bland annat att:

    Rigga verktyg, ställa och köra CNC-maskiner
    Läsa och följa ritningar och tillverkningsunderlag
    Mäta och kvalitetssäkra genom att arbeta enligt principen ”Rätt från mig”
    Programmera och justera CNC-program och bearbetningsdata, beroende på maskin och erfarenhet
    Bidra till förbättringar av metoder, kvalitet och produktionseffektivitet
    Utföra operatörsunderhåll och daglig tillsyn av maskinerna

Inriktning svarvning

Inom svarvningen arbetar vi bland annat i maskiner från Okuma och Mori Seiki/DMG MORI. Maskinparken omfattar fleroperationssvarvar med bland annat Y-axel, motspindel, stångmatning och robotladdning.

Inriktning fräsning

Inom fräsningen arbetar vi med tre-, fyr- och femaxlig bearbetning. Vi investerar i ny maskinkapacitet och installerar senare i år två nya fräsmaskiner från DMG MORI.

Vem söker vi?

Vi tror att du har erfarenhet av CNC-bearbetning eller en relevant industriteknisk utbildning. Det viktigaste är att du är tekniskt intresserad, noggrann och vill utvecklas inom yrket.

Vi ser gärna att du:

    Har erfarenhet av CNC-svarvning eller CNC-fräsning
    Kan läsa tekniska ritningar
    Har kunskap om skärande bearbetning och mätteknik
    Är kvalitetsmedveten och tar ansvar för ditt arbete
    Trivs med att arbeta både självständigt och tillsammans med andra
    Har en positiv inställning och är beredd att hugga i där det behövs
    Behärskar svenska i tal och skrift



Erfarenhet av programmering är meriterande men inget krav. Även erfarenhet av fleroperationsmaskiner, fleraxlig bearbetning, automation eller tillverkning i små och medelstora serier är meriterande.

Vi är intresserade av både erfarna CNC-operatörer och personer som befinner sig i början av sin yrkeskarriär men har rätt utbildning, driv och vilja att lära sig.

Vi erbjuder

Hos RZ Ölme blir du en del av ett mindre företag med korta beslutsvägar, engagerade kollegor och stora möjligheter att påverka. Vi kombinerar 40 års erfarenhet av skärande bearbetning med investeringar i ny teknik och en tydlig ambition att fortsätta utveckla verksamheten.

Vi erbjuder bland annat:

    Ett varierande och tekniskt utvecklande arbete
    En modern och varierad CNC-maskinpark som fortsätter att utvecklas
    Korta beslutsvägar och möjlighet att påverka arbetssätt och förbättringar
    En trygg och trivsam arbetsplats med kollektivavtal
    Friskvårdsbidrag

Tjänsterna är på heltid och arbetstiden är förlagd till tvåskift.

Om RZ Ölme

RZ Ölme är en kvalificerad leverantör inom CNC-bearbetning med verksamhet i Kristinehamn. Vi har 40 års erfarenhet av skärande bearbetning och tillverkar tekniskt komplexa detaljer genom svarvning och fräsning – från prototyper och mindre volymer till återkommande serieproduktion.

Företaget är en del av RZ-gruppen och är certifierat enligt ISO 9001 och ISO 14001.

Ansökan

Skicka din ansökan och ditt CV till viktor.eriksson@olmemekaniska.se.

Märk ansökan med ”CNC-operatör svarvning” eller ”CNC-operatör fräsning”, beroende på vilken inriktning du är intresserad av.

Urval och intervjuer sker löpande, så skicka gärna din ansökan så snart som möjligt. Tillträde sker enligt överenskommelse.

Har du frågor om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta oss på samma e-postadress.

title: Hemstädare till Suzzie Städ
description:
Älskar du känslan av ett riktigt rent hem? Då kanske du är vår nästa Suzzie stjärna ✨

Suzzie Städ växer och vi söker fler människor som vill vara med på vår resa.

Vi har en tydlig ambition. Vi vill leverera hemstädning av högsta klass och skapa en serviceupplevelse som våra kunder längtar efter att komma hem till.

För oss handlar riktigt bra hemstädning om mycket mer än att bara städa.

Det handlar om att se detaljerna. Att bry sig om resultatet. Att förstå vilket förtroende det innebär att få kliva in i någons hem och att lämna det med känslan av att vi har tagit hand om det som om det vore vårt eget.

Därför söker vi inte bara dig som kan städa.

Vi söker dig som brinner för det.

Dig som känner den där lilla extra stoltheten när du tittar dig omkring efter avslutat arbete och tänker:

Wow. Här blev det riktigt fint.

Vem är du?

Du är en person som är noggrann, ansvarstagande och har ett öga för detaljer.

Du tycker om att ge riktigt bra service och förstår att det ofta är de små sakerna som skapar den stora upplevelsen för kunden.

Du trivs med att arbeta självständigt, men vill samtidigt tillhöra ett team där vi bryr oss om varandra, hjälps åt och tillsammans arbetar mot samma mål.

Tidigare erfarenhet av hemstädning är meriterande, men för oss är din inställning, din känsla för kvalitet och din vilja att göra ett fantastiskt jobb minst lika viktig.

Varför Suzzie?

Suzzie Städ är en del av QLNR och vi befinner oss på en spännande resa.

Vi vill bygga ett hemstädsföretag som sticker ut. Både för våra kunder och för våra medarbetare.

Ett företag där hög kvalitet och personlig service går hand i hand. Där våra kunder känner sig trygga med människorna de släpper in i sina hem. Där våra medarbetare känner stolthet över sitt yrke, sitt arbete och över att vara en del av Suzzie.

Vi vill helt enkelt bli riktigt, riktigt bra på det vi gör.

Och för att lyckas med det behöver vi rätt människor med oss på resan.

Människor som bryr sig. Som ser detaljerna. Som vill utvecklas. Och som känner samma stolthet som vi gör över att leverera något riktigt bra.

Känner du igen dig?

Då hoppas vi att du blir en av oss 💛

Suzzie Städ En del av QLNR

Ett rent hem. En enklare vardag. Hos oss är det människorna som gör skillnaden. Vi tror på att en bra arbetsmiljö skapar både glada medarbetare och nöjda kunder. Därför satsar vi på dig, din utveckling och din framtid.

📩 Redo att börja? Skicka in din ansökan redan idag och bli en del av Suzzie & QLNR-familjen – vi längtar efter att träffa dig!

title: Vi söker dig som vill extrajobba på Dirty Taco
description:
Om jobbet

Gillar du högt tempo, bra stämning och att få gästerna att gå därifrån med ett leende? Då kan det här vara ditt nästa extrajobb!

Vi söker dig som brinner för service och trivs i en livlig atmosfär där ingen dag är den andra lik. Du gillar utmaningar, gillar att gasa på när det är fullt tryck – och för dig är det självklart att ge gästerna en grym upplevelse.

Har du ett genuint intresse för servicejobb och känner att restaurangbranschen är din grej? Då är du precis den vi letar efter, oavsett om du redan har erfarenhet av à la carte-servering eller är sugen på att lära dig. Du är flexibel, kan hoppa in med kort varsel och trivs lika bra en lugn tisdag som en stökig fredagskväll.

Vad erbjuder vi?

• Extraarbete med varierande pass, ofta kvällar och helger

• En rolig och dynamisk arbetsplats med härligt tempo

• Ett sammansvetsat team där vi stöttar och peppar varandra

• Chansen att växa och utvecklas inom restaurangbranschen

• Lön och villkor enligt kollektivavtal

description:

title: Consultants Strategy Consulting | EY-Parthenon | Gothenburg
description:
Are you ready to shape the future with confidence?



At EY-Parthenon Strategy, you will have the opportunity to create exceptional experiences. We equip you with cutting-edge technology, surround you with high-performing teams, and offer the global reach and inclusive culture needed to unlock your full potential. Through our fast-paced working environment, expertise, and learning programs, you will develop the skills required to stay relevant today and, in the future, while building a network of colleagues, mentors, and leaders who will support you throughout your journey, both within EY and beyond.





The opportunity: your next adventure awaits



EY-Parthenon Strategy is looking for students with exceptional skills to join our rapidly growing team in Stockholm or Gothenburg to work on private equity deals and strategy across the Nordics, Europe, and the world. We offer a developing, social, and internationally characterized workplace. You will work with some of the world’s leading companies — our clients. As a consultant, you can expect to engage with private equity and corporate clients on strategy as well as strategic M&A projects across sectors.





What we are looking for



    You have an agile and growth-oriented mindset. What you know matters, but your attitude is just as important for success. We seek individuals who are innovative, adaptable, and thrive in a fast-changing world.
    You are curious and purpose driven. You see opportunities instead of challenges and ask better questions to find better answers.
    You are inclusive. You actively seek and embrace diverse perspectives, value differences, and work together to build trust and psychological safety.





Qualifications



    Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, or equivalent, with strong academic results
    Excellent communication skills in English
    Expected graduation in spring 2027 or earlier





What we offer you



    Develop your strategic, commercial, and leadership skills through future-focused environment, courses, and development programs
    Broaden your perspective by working in highly integrated teams across the globe and collaborating with people from diverse professional and cultural backgrounds
    Bring out your best self by continuously investing in your personal well-being and career development
    Build your personal value and help create a positive impact on our teams, business, clients, and society as a whole





Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.



We warmly welcome your application. Please submit your CV, cover letter, and university transcripts no later than October 11th, 2026. Applications are screened continuously and apply before September 27th to be included in first intake window. For questions about the role, contact recruitmentse@parthenon.ey.com.



Please note that a background check will be conducted as part of the recruitment process.



At EY, we value diversity and encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds. If you have questions, need support, or require adjustments to the recruitment process due to a disability, please contact us at recruitmentsweden@se.ey.com. We are here to support you.

title: Analyst Financial Transaction Diligence | EY Parthenon | Malmö
description:
Will you shape the future or will the future shape you?



Are you curious, driven, and eager to dive into the world of M&A? At EY-Parthenon, our Transaction Diligence team plays a key role in helping clients unlock value and manage risk throughout their M&A journeys. We dive deep into company performance across industries and provide strategic financial insights that guide critical decisions. Working across geographies and disciplines, you’ll gain exposure to a wide range of sectors and collaborate with diverse teams.



We’re currently looking for ambitious graduates and professionals with up to two years of experience to join us. We offer two annual start dates, in January and August 2027.





The opportunity: your next adventure awaits



As part of EY-Parthenon, you’ll work on both buy-side and sell-side transactions. You’ll assess financial performance, identify risks and opportunities, and support clients in making informed decisions. Your responsibilities will include:



    Evaluating profitability (EBIT/EBITDA)
    Identifying key business drivers — “the story behind the numbers”
    Analyzing net working capital requirements
    Advising on transaction risks and mitigation strategies
    Supporting purchase price adjustments and closing mechanisms



Our teams bring together professionals across all transaction and strategy competence areas, bringing sector expertise and teams from multiple geographies to provide a complete set of advisory around transactions to help our clients achieve their objectives. By conducting a thorough analysis of financial data, you will identify and quantify the factors that drive a company's value. This is essential not only to understand the company's historical performance but also to spotting potential risks and opportunities that could affect future value.





What we look for



We’re looking for curious and driven individuals who thrive in fast-paced environments and enjoy solving complex problems. You bring strong business acumen, an analytical mindset, and a collaborative spirit. You’re adaptable, eager to learn, and passionate about working with diverse teams across industries. Whether through studies, work, or extracurriculars, you’ve shown initiative and a genuine interest in M&A.





Qualifications



    Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Industrial Management, or Engineering
    Strong academic performance
    Fluency in English and at least one Nordic language
    Proficient in Microsoft Office





Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.



Please submit your application now including your CV, cover letter, and university transcripts. Selection and interviews will be conducted on an ongoing basis.



If you have questions about the role, please contact Nathalie.Jonoska@parthenon.ey.com. For questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact Amanda.hederstedt@se.ey.com.



Please note that a background check will be conducted as part of the recruitment process.



At EY, we value diversity and encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds. If you have any questions, need support, or require adjustments to the recruitment process due to a disability, don’t hesitate to contact us at recruitmentsweden@se.ey.com. We are here to support you.

title: Assisterande tränare
description:
About FC Rosengård Elitfotboll AB

At FC Rosengård, we are more than just a football club, we are a movement. We sit at the intersection of elite sporting performance and deep-rooted social responsibility. We're expanding the organisation around our elite women's team, competing in Damallsvenskan, and are now looking for an Assistant Coach to support the first team's development on and off the pitch.

Role Overview

The Assistant Coach works directly within FC Rosengård's first team coaching setup, supporting training delivery, matchday preparation, and tactical development for the squad competing in Damallsvenskan. A core part of the role is designing and delivering individualised development work, technical, tactical, physical, and psychological, that complements team training and accelerates each player's growth. The role bridges team-level coaching with the personalised attention players need to reach their full potential.

Key Responsibilities

Player Assessment & Development Planning

    Conduct detailed individual player assessments across technical, tactical, cognitive, physical, and psycho-social domains.
    Create, implement, and regularly review Individual Development Plans (IDPs) for each assigned player in collaboration with the Head of Coaching, age-group coaches, and sport science staff.
    Use video analysis, data analytics, and performance metrics to identify development priorities and track progress over time.
    Maintain detailed records of each player's development journey, including session notes, milestone achievements, and areas requiring further focus.

1-to-1 and Small-Group Coaching

    Plan and deliver high-quality individual and small-group training sessions tailored to each player's and position groups development needs.
    Focus on technical skill refinement (e.g., first touch, passing range, finishing, dribbling, defending technique), decision-making, positional understanding, and game intelligence.
    Design progressive session plans that challenge players appropriately and align with the club's playing philosophy and curriculum.
    Use creative, engaging, and evidence-based coaching methods to maximize learning and retention.

Integration with the Wider Coaching Program

    Work closely with Head of Football and age-group lead coaches to ensure individual development work complements and reinforces team training objectives.
    Provide feedback to HoF/coaching staff on individual player progress, readiness, and any concerns.
    Support the transition of players between age groups and phases of development, where applicable and within the club’s remit.
    Contribute to the club's coaching curriculum and methodology by sharing insights from individual work where appropriate.

Performance Analysis & Feedback

    Utilize video analysis tools (e.g., Hudl, Sportscode, Catapult) to review match and training footage with players on an individual basis.
    Deliver clear, constructive, and age-appropriate feedback that empowers players to take ownership of their development.
    Set short-, medium-, and long-term goals collaboratively with each player.



Holistic Player Development

    Support players' psychological development, including confidence, resilience, motivation, and a growth mindset.
    Liaise with sport psychologists, sport scientists, physiotherapists, nutritionists, and education/welfare officers to ensure a holistic approach.
    Act as a mentor and trusted point of contact for players and, where appropriate, their parents/guardians.
    Promote positive attitudes toward learning, self-reflection, and professionalism.

Continued Professional Development

    Stay current with best practices in individual player development, coaching science, motor learning, and talent development research.

title: Process Integration Engineer
description:
Responsibilities:

Wafer Process Ownership

    Own and optimize the integrated wafer fabrication process flow for assigned products.
    Define and maintain wafer process specifications and control strategies, including MES process flow setup.
    Analyze process, inline, and test data to understand process behavior and improve yield and manufacturability.
    Investigate and resolve process deviations and product test failures through systematic root cause analysis.
    Implement corrective and preventive actions to improve yield, process stability, and product quality.
    Provide shop floor guidance and support manufacturing teams during process issues.
    Maintain technical documentation including process specifications, change records, and experimental results.

New Product Introduction

    Design and optimize integrated process flows to enable new products and device concepts.
    Collaborate with Chip Design and Process Engineering to balance device performance and manufacturability.
    Plan and manage wafer lots used for prototyping and product development.
    Characterize integrated processes and evaluate the impact of process and design tolerances on yield and device performance.
    Support ramp-up and stabilization of new products in manufacturing.

Process and Technology Development

    Development and optimization of new process integration technologies for current and next-generation InP PIC platforms to expand process capability.
    Plan and execute experiments to develop and optimize process modules.
    Ensure new integration technologies reach maturity suitable for product process flows.

Collaboration

    Work closely with Chip Design, Process Engineering, Product Engineering, Manufacturing, and Quality teams.
    Collaborate with global Coherent sites (e.g. Sherman, Fremont, Zürich)



Skills & Qualifications:        

We are looking for candidates with a strong foundation in semiconductor processing, process integration, and device physics. Experience with III-V or photonic device fabrication is highly advantageous but not required.

Required

    MSc or PhD in Engineering Physics, Electrical Engineering, Optoelectronics, or a related field.
    Hands-on experience working with semiconductor fabrication processes and equipment in a cleanroom environment.
    Familiarity with semiconductor fabrication processes such as epitaxy, wet etching, plasma etching, thin-film deposition, and photolithography.
    Experience in semiconductor process integration, process engineering, or related roles in a semiconductor fabrication environment.
    Experience developing or supporting semiconductor processes from development through product ramp and high-volume manufacturing.
    Experience with III–V semiconductor or photonic device fabrication is highly advantageous, but candidates with relevant experience from other semiconductor technologies are also encouraged to apply.

Technical Skills

    Strong understanding of semiconductor process integration and interactions between multiple fabrication steps.
    Ability to analyze manufacturing, inline, and test data to understand process behavior and identify root causes of yield or device performance issues.
    Experience with statistical methods and tools for process analysis and control (e.g., DOE, FMEA, JMP or similar tools).
    Experience with process characterization and metrology techniques such as SEM, EDX, electrical measurements, and materials analysis.
    Experience with CAD layout tools for lithography mask design is beneficial.
    Knowledge of optoelectronic device physics or III–V device design is a plus.

Language

    Fluent in English.
     Swedish proficiency is an advantage, with willingness to develop working proficiency.

Who You Are

    Self-driven and naturally curious, with strong motivation to understand underlying process and device interactions and drive technical solutions to completion.
    Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex process and test data and identify root causes of yield or device performance issues.
    Detail-oriented and structured, with the ability to track and organize complex process information across multiple fabrication steps, experiments, and datasets.
    Clear and effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present technical analyses and recommendations to cross-functional engineering teams.
    Ability to collaborate effectively with teams including chip design, process engineering, manufacturing, product engineering, and quality.
    Ability to understand different perspectives and translate technical requirements into clear and practical process instructions for manufacturing teams.

In this role, you will apply these capabilities in a highly collaborative environment, where clear communication, ownership, and continuous improvement are essential.

We believe you demonstrate behaviors aligned with our ICARE values:

    Integrity – You take ownership and ensure high quality and accuracy in your work
    Collaboration – You work effectively across teams and functions
    Accountability – You drive results and take responsibility for outcomes
    Respect – You value different perspectives and contribute to a positive work environment
    Excellence – You are curious, analytical, and continuously seek improvements

Working Environment

    A substantial portion of the work takes place in the wafer fabrication cleanroom, particularly during process development, product ramp-up, and manufacturing issue resolution.
    Combination of hands-on work, analysis, and cross-functional collaboration.

Recruitment Process

At Coherent, we follow a structured and fair recruitment process:

    Applications are reviewed continuously
    Initial screening by HR
    Competency-based interviews with hiring manager and team
    Final candidates may undergo background checks, reference checks, and medical testing (including alcohol and drug testing)
    For some roles, union consultation may be required before final decision

We encourage internal candidates to apply and explore development opportunities within Coherent.

Additional Information

    This role has no direct reports
    Senior candidates may take on mentoring responsibilities
    Right to work in Sweden is required

title: Industrial Designer (ICT)
description:
Industrial Designer (ICT)

We are looking for a Senior Industrial Designer to join a highly creative, international, and multidisciplinary design team in Stockholm.

This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of design, technology, innovation, and human experience, creating next-generation connected products for a global market.

From telecom equipment and smart home solutions to automotive technologies and intelligent connected devices, you will help transform emerging ideas into products that are not only technically advanced, but also desirable, intuitive, and beautifully designed.

The Role

As a Senior Industrial Designer, you will play a key role in shaping products from early insights and strategic concepts through to final product realization.

You will turn observations of users, emerging design trends, societal changes, and evolving business models into compelling design concepts, meaningful user experiences, and innovative product solutions.

You have a highly developed sensitivity for form, proportion, color, materials, and finishes (CMF). You understand that great industrial design is about more than aesthetics – it is about creating meaning, communicating a brand, and delivering an exceptional experience.

You are not simply a stylist. You are a creative problem-solver and innovator who combines strategic thinking with hands-on design skills and a strong passion for detail.

You are comfortable bringing ideas to life quickly through:

    Sketching and visual storytelling
    3D modeling and rendering
    Prototyping and model making
    3D printing and physical exploration
    Design workshops and ideation sessions
    Presentations and design reviews

You know when to zoom out and think strategically – and when to zoom in and obsess over the smallest detail.

Key Responsibilities

In this role, you will:

    Be a key contributor to a creative industrial design team developing innovative connected products.
    Lead design projects from research and early concept development through to successful product realization.
    Take ownership of the industrial design function within multidisciplinary project teams.
    Collaborate closely with designers, engineers, product developers, and business stakeholders.
    Communicate design concepts and decisions clearly and inspire stakeholders throughout the design journey.
    Lead design activities, facilitate workshops, and provide constructive feedback to fellow designers and multidisciplinary teams.
    Contribute to cohesive product portfolios and strengthen brand expression through design.
    Stay ahead of competitors, emerging technologies, industry developments, and global design trends.
    Balance human desirability, business viability, and technical feasibility in every design decision.

About You

You are an experienced industrial designer with strong creative capabilities, commercial awareness, and a genuine curiosity about people, technology, and the world around you.

We expect you to have:

    6–8+ years of professional industrial design experience, with significant experience from a consultancy, design studio, or similarly dynamic environment.
    A BA or MA in Industrial Design, Design Engineering, or a related discipline.
    Proven experience leading projects involving multiple designers while remaining actively involved in hands-on design work.
    An outstanding sense of form, proportion, color, materials, and finishes (CMF).
    A strong understanding of global design, technology, and consumer trends.
    Knowledge of materials, manufacturing processes, and product development.
    Hands-on experience with model making, prototyping, and testing.
    Strong proficiency in tools such as Creo, Rhino, KeyShot, Adobe Creative Suite, or equivalent.
    A proven track record of delivering successful industrial design projects in an international environment.
    Experience designing consumer products is considered a strong advantage.
    A strong portfolio demonstrating creativity, innovation, design excellence, and successful product development.

Your Personality

You are curious, proactive, self-driven, and highly collaborative.

You enjoy challenging assumptions, exploring new ideas, and finding creative solutions to complex problems. At the same time, you are structured, detail-oriented, and capable of taking ownership from the first idea to the final outcome.

You are a confident communicator and presenter who can make complex design ideas easy to understand and bring stakeholders along on the journey.

You thrive in international, multidisciplinary environments and enjoy working with people from different backgrounds and areas of expertise.

Most importantly, you are passionate about creating meaningful products, outstanding user experiences, and design that makes a difference.

Location & Assignment

Location: Stockholm, Sweden

Scope: Full-time

Assignment: Consulting assignment through Clevry, initially for 12 months

The Recruitment Process

Clevry is responsible for the recruitment process for this consulting assignment.

We review applications continuously, so the position may be filled before the application deadline.

We look forward to receiving your application!

About Clevry

For more than 30 years, Clevry has been at the forefront of creating a more soft skills-driven workplace, specializing in talent acquisition, assessment, and advisory.

With a global presence spanning from North America to Singapore, Clevry works with clients, consultants, and candidates across international markets. Our headquarters are located in Brighton, Stockholm, and Helsinki.

Our team of 150 soft skills-certified recruiters, business psychologists, and specialists is dedicated to helping organizations and people find the right match – and unlock their full potential.

Our goal is clear – we want to be the best employer in the industry. We believe our employees are the heart of the company, and we are dedicated to providing good working conditions.  

Among others, we offer:

    

A permanent position of a 85% employment rate.  

    

Collective agreement and favorable terms of employment.

    

Liability insurance, health insurance, and pension insurance.

    

Wellness allowance.

    

Training in home cleaning, with a focus on your development.

    

Great career opportunities and growth within Hemfrid.

    

Free mobile subscription.  

    

One of Sweden’s greatest teams of colleagues from all over the world. 🙌

About the role

As a home cleaner in the service team, you are responsible for cleaning our customers’ homes with the highest quality. Your main tasks will include covering for absent colleagues, performing deep cleans (which make up a large part of the role), and managing keys.

You will often work alongside your colleagues and be responsible for ensuring the quality of these assignments. In addition, as part of the service team, you are expected to lead and coordinate the work during deep cleaning assignments.

To thrive in this role, you should enjoy working at a fast pace and be adaptable to different situations.

About us

Hemfrid is Sweden's leading provider of home services. We help our customers with cleaning, laundry, ironing, moving, gardening, and more. By working as a team and providing easy access to first-class home services, we unlock people's quality of life.  

Our process

After completing the application, you will be contacted by the HR department regarding the recruitment process for your application.

As part of our recruitment process, we always do a background check. You need to have a Swedish personal number or a coordination number to be eligible for this position.  

Are you ready to unlock people's quality of life? Great! So are we. We look forward to your application.

Welcome to Hemfrid



Vi letar efter nya hemstädare till vårt serviceteam i området Västerort. Är du vår nästa stjärna? 🌟

Din profil

Vi älskar att göra våra kunders vardag enklare – det borde du också göra. Vi söker efter någon som brinner för kundservice. Du är punktlig och ansvarstagande, med ett öga för detaljer och en positiv inställning. Självklart är du en lagspelare som tycker om att arbeta nära dina kollegor.

Du bör:

    

Ha tidigare erfarenhet från ett serviceyrke.

    

Ha arbetat som hemstädare, hushållerska eller motsvarande.

    

Tala och förstå grundläggande svenska eller engelska.

    

Kunna arbeta flexibla timmar, måndag – fredag, mellan 8 – 17.

Vi erbjuder

Vårt mål är tydligt – vi vill vara branschens bästa arbetsgivare. Vi tror att våra anställda är företagets hjärta, och vi är dedikerade till att erbjuda bra arbetsförhållanden.

Bland annat erbjuder vi:

    

En tillsvidareanställning på 85% sysselsättningsgrad.

    

Kollektivavtal och bra anställningsvillkor

    

Ansvarsförsäkring, sjukförsäkring och pensionsförsäkring.

    

Friskvårdsbidrag.

    

Utbildning inom hemstädning, med fokus på din utveckling.

    

Goda möjligheter att utvecklas och växa inom Hemfrid.

    

Gratis mobilabonnemang.

    

Ett av Sveriges härligaste team med kollegor från hela världen. 🙌

Om rollen

Som hemstädare i serviceteamet ansvarar du för att städa våra kunders hem med högsta kvalitet. Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter kommer vara att täcka upp vid frånvaro, utföra storstädningar (vilket är en stor del av uppdraget), samt hjälpa att hantera nycklar.

Du kommer ofta att arbeta tillsammans med dina kollegor och ha ansvar för kvalitetssäkring av uppdragen. Inom serviceteamet förväntas du även kunna leda och fördela arbetet vid storstädningar.

För att trivas i den här rollen bör du gilla att arbeta i ett högt tempo och vara flexibel samt anpassningsbar.

Om oss

Hemfrid är Sveriges ledande aktör för tjänster i hemmet. Vi hjälper våra kunder med städning, tvätt, strykning, flytt, trädgårdsarbete och mycket mer. Genom att arbeta som ett team och ge våra kunder enkel tillgång till våra toppklassiga tjänster förbättrar vi deras livskvalitet.

Vår process

Efter genomförd ansökan kommer du att bli kontaktad av HR- avdelningen angående rekryteringsprocessen för din ansökan.

Som en del av vår rekryteringsprocess genomför vi bakgrundskontroller. För att vara kvalificerad för den här tjänsten behöver du ha ett svenskt personnummer eller ett samordningsnummer.

Är du redo att förbättra människors livskvalitet? Bra! Det är vi också. Vi ser fram emot din ansökan.

Välkommen till Hemfrid!

title: Junior Engine Test Engineer
description:
About the Company

At Avaron, you get the security of permanent employment combined with the variety of working at different customers. We place specialists across everything from tech, IT and industry to project management and business support – and whatever the assignment, you have a consultant manager who is there for you and your development.

About the Role

You will work hands-on in an advanced automotive test environment where engines, test cells, and measurement systems need to perform reliably around the clock. In this role, you help prepare and run tests, secure the quality of measurement data, and keep the testbed environment stable and robust. You will be part of a collaborative team working close to both test equipment and test objects, with a clear focus on practical problem-solving and continuous improvement. This is a great opportunity if you want to build your career in automotive testing and gain deep exposure to engine test systems in a technically demanding setting.

Job Description

    

You will prepare test cells, test objects, and associated equipment for planned test activities.

    

You will install engines in the test cell and connect the equipment relevant for each test.

    

You will set up and run tests in the test cells and help ensure correct test execution.

    

You will monitor measurement data quality and help make sure the required quality level is met.

    

You will report issues with test cells or test objects and actively contribute to fault tracing and troubleshooting.

    

You will perform service work and support maintenance to keep the testbeds capable, robust, and available with high uptime.

    

You will handle daily updates of time reporting and diaries.

    

You will provide technical support within the team when needed.

    

You will write instructions and how-to materials and help keep knowledge within the area up to date.

Requirements

    

B.Sc. or Technical college graduate together with working experience of similar tasks.

    

Good knowledge of automotive test cell systems, including AVL PUMA and ETAS INCA.

    

Fluent in Swedish and English.

Nice to have

    

Experience from mechanical work or testing.

    

Forklift license and driver's license.

What We Offer

    Permanent employment at Avaron AB
    Occupational pension
    Wellness allowance of SEK 5,000 per year

Application

Selections are made on an ongoing basis – apply as soon as you can.

title: Systems Architect to Mycronic PCB Assembly Solutions
description:
Mycronic is a global high-tech company whose innovative solutions have been advancing electronics technology for over 50 years. Today we continue to grow and serve customers in an expanding variety of industries. What we do impacts the future of technology, and in turn, the way we live our lives tomorrow. We’re looking for people to join our talented, motivated and friendly team on the cutting-edge. Here, in an open, collaborative and flexible environment, you’ll work alongside leading industry experts and take on challenging projects that bring tomorrow’s electronics to life. Do you enjoy solving complex technical challenges and shaping the architecture of advanced products? Then you might be the person we’re looking for!

About the role

Mycronic has experienced strong growth in recent years, both organically and through acquisitions. With headquarters in Sweden, Mycronic is a global organization with subsidiaries, agents, and distributors in over 50 countries. In this role, you will be part of Mycronic's PCB Assembly Solutions division (PA), a leading provider of equipment and solutions for surface mount technology (SMT). Our solutions enable electronics manufacturers to adapt production quickly while maintaining high efficiency, ranging from individual systems for specific process steps to complete production lines and advanced software for assembly process management and connected factories.

We Offer

    A strategic role where you will have a significant influence on the direction of our world-leading Jet Printing product.
    The opportunity to work with new technology and contribute to innovation together with our Jet Printing core development team of 15 specialists across software, mechanics, electronics, configuration management, testing, product management, as well as collaborate with a wide range of functions across the company.
    A culture of innovation and collaboration, working together at our Kista office.

Work tasks

As a Systems Architect, you will lead the definition, development, and evolution of robust, scalable, and sustainable system architectures. You will provide the architectural perspective that connects our engineering disciplines and helps translate business and customer needs into technical direction. To do this effectively, you will invest the necessary time to truly understand our products and customers. This includes gaining firsthand experience of their perspective by using our systems during experiments, exploring new opportunities, and developing a deep understanding of how our solutions are used in practice.

Your responsibilities will include:

    

Lead and align cross-functional technical development, ensuring that software, electronics, mechanics, and mechatronics work together as an integrated system.

    

Explore and drive the use of AI to deepen our understanding of the product, identify new opportunities, and improve how we develop and evolve our solutions.

    

Lead workshops and facilitate discussions around business and technical needs. Balance the overall architectural perspective with the necessary technical details while engaging others in developing concepts that meet customer and product requirements.

    

Support sales at customer-specific development by performing requirement analyses and product definition.

    

Establish, develop and share knowledge of current and future manufacturing technologies.

We are looking for

You are a true team player with an open and positive mindset, a strong sense of responsibility, and the ability to thrive in a global, fast-changing environment. You bring a pragmatic approach to product development, knowing when to push for improvements and when to recognize what already works well. You communicate clearly and effectively with people across different roles and areas of expertise, and take a thoughtful, structured approach to moving work forward, understanding what needs to be done, which competencies are needed, and when to involve the right people.

Furthermore, you have:

    A Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering Physics, Electronics, Mechatronics or similar.
    Solid experience in systems architecture for complex products combining hardware and software.
    Solid knowledge of systems engineering, both theoretical and practical.
    Experience translating stakeholder requirements into technical solutions.
    Strong ability to lead technical discussions and drive decisions.
    Experience leading technical projects or product development activities.
    Strong communication skills in English.

It will be considered a merit if you have:

    Knowledge of Swedish.
    Proven experience in exploring and driving the use of AI in product development.

Other information

    Start: By agreement
    Location: Stockholm, Kista
    Employment: Permanent, Full-time.
    Contact information: Senior Recruitment Consultant Johanna Sörell, johanna.sorell@academicwork.se. Recruitment Coordinator Vera Mohlin, vera.mohlin@academicwork.se.
    This recruitment process is managed by Academic Work. Mycronic requests that all questions regarding the position are directed to Academic Work.
    Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase.

Our recruitment process

    Problem solving- and personality test
    Phone interview with Academic Work
    In-depth interview with Academic Work
    Interviews with Mycronic
    Reference checking & decision

title: Sales Manager to Beyond Gravity Linköping
description:

title: Fellowship in reconstructive microsurgery
description:
Verksamhetsområde plastik- och käkkirurgi

Vi är Akademiska sjukhuset – ett av Sveriges ledande universitetssjukhus. Som länssjukhus och leverantör av högspecialiserad vård erbjuder vi vård till två miljoner människor i Mellansverige. Här händer det ständigt något – ett nytt liv föds, en mormor opereras, en kollega hyllas som hjälte. Hos oss får du uppleva både hårda prövningar och fantastiska händelser, i en stark gemenskap med kollegor. Välkommen med din ansökan!

Program Description
The department of Plastic and Maxillofacial surgery offers a 6-month fellowship in reconstructive microsurgery. Uppsala is one of the more active units in reconstructive microsurgery in northern Europe with a case load consisting of more than 120 free flaps, 50 complex non microvascular cases in the areas of head and neck reconstruction, breast reconstruction, facial paralysis, lower extremity and complex wound care and more than 50 lymphaticovenous operations per year. The free flap service includes head and neck reconstructions, lower extremity, facial palsy, breast and lymphoedema. The fellowship program is endorsed by the Swedish Society for Reconstructive Microsurgery.

Fellowship Responsibilities
The fellow will work in a team of specialists and residents and will participate in the planning and execution of the reconstructive cases performed by the team. The fellow will participate in all teaching activities in the department and will be responsible for around one monthly presentation.
The fellow is required to undertake one research project within microsurgery and is expected to finish one publication.

Salary
Competitive salary and possibility for accommodation in Uppsala.

Requirements
The candidate must be specialist in plastic surgery or finish a training program in plastic surgery and have an ambition to pursue a career in reconstructive microsurgery and be able to work in a team.

How to apply
Submit your CV and two letters of recommendation.

Contact
Andres Rodriguez, andres.rodriguez.lorenzo@akademiska.se (andres.rodriguez.lorenzo@akademiska.se)

Facklig kontaktperson nås via Upplands Allmänna Läkarförening, kansli 018-611 34 95

Vill du jobba med oss?
Välkommen med din ansökan via länken nedan.

OBS! Viktig information gällande din ansökan:
• Tillsättning av tjänster för specialistutbildade läkare på universitetssjukhus kräver sakkunnigprövning enligt Hälso- och sjukvårdsförordningen (2017:80) 5 kap. 8§.
• CV, personligt brev och specialistläkarbevis utfärdat av Socialstyrelsen ska alltid bifogas.
• Disputationsbevis ska bifogas ansökan gällande befattningar där akademisk meritering i form av doktorsexamen eller motsvarande är kompetenskrav.
• Även om du tidigare sökt tjänster hos Akademiska sjukhuset, behöver du skicka in ovanstående dokument för att ansökan ska vara komplett. Samtliga handlingar ska vara oss tillhanda senast sista ansökningsdag. En ofullständig ansökan går inte vidare i processen.
• Tjänsteförslagen publiceras på Region Uppsalas officiella anslagstavla; https://regionuppsala.se/politik-och-paverkan/handlingar/anslagstavla/

Läs om anställningsvillkor och lönesättning inom Region Uppsala här: Bli vår nya kollega (https://regionuppsala.se/jobb-och-utbildning/bli-var-nya-kollega/)

Region Uppsala värdesätter de kvaliteter som jämn könsfördelning och mångfald tillför verksamheten och ser gärna sökande av alla kön och med olika födelsebakgrund, funktionalitet och livserfarenhet.

Region Uppsala krigsplacerar all tillsvidareanställd personal utifrån totalförsvarets behov. Detta innebär för den enskilda medarbetaren inga förpliktelser i fredstid utan är enkom en planeringsåtgärd.

Inför beslut om anställning, sker kontroll av misstanke- och belastningsregister avseende samtliga arbetssökanden som i den sökta anställningen kan komma att arbeta inom psykiatrisk sjukvård, habilitering, vård av barn och ungdom eller tvångsvård av missbrukare, områden som omfattas av fakultativa registerutdrag. Detta gäller således alla som kommer att arbeta patientnära, även om arbetsuppgifterna i nuläget inte är tänkta att huvudsakligen innehålla arbete med ovan nämnda patientgrupper.

Denna rekrytering sker helt genom Region Uppsalas försorg och vi undanber oss telefonsamtal från rekryteringsföretag och annonsförsäljare.

title: Car repair & maintanance
description:
About us

Green SM is a leading electric vehicle (EV) and sustainable mobility solutions provider headquartered in Vietnam. With a commitment to transforming urban transportation, we have successfully expanded into the Global Market and are now preparing to launch operations in the EU Market. Join us in driving the future of sustainable mobility.

Website: Green SM - Electric Mobility Service, 5-Star Quality | Green SM

Position Overview

The Repair and Maintenance Specialist is responsible for supporting daily vehicle repair, maintenance, and roadworthiness operations in the assigned market. This role will work closely with workshops, body & paint shops, tire vendors, glass repair partners, insurance providers, and internal fleet teams to ensure vehicles are repaired quickly, maintained properly, and returned to operation with minimum downtime.

Key Responsibilities

Repair & Maintenance Operations

· Coordinate daily repair and maintenance activities for GSM Europe’s vehicle fleet in the assigned market.

· Follow up with service providers on routine servicing, accident repairs, body damage, glass repair, and mechanical issues.

· Ensure all vehicles follow mandatory maintenance schedules and comply with local roadworthiness inspection requirements.

· Monitor vehicle repair status and ensure timely updates in internal fleet management systems.

Workshop & Service Partner Coordination

· Act as the key contact point for workshops, body & paint shops, tire vendors, glass repair partners, and other maintenance providers.

· Follow up on repair timelines, spare parts availability, service quality, and vehicle handover status.

· Support the evaluation of workshop performance, including turnaround time, service quality, and cost efficiency.

· Escalate delayed repairs, repeated technical issues, or service quality concerns to management.

Tire, Glass & Roadworthiness Management

· Support seasonal tire operations, including winter/summer tire changes, tire storage, tire wear tracking, and replacement planning.

· Coordinate glass repair and replacement cases to reduce vehicle downtime.

· Track vehicle inspection deadlines and ensure vehicles remain compliant with local safety and roadworthiness regulations.

· Support preventive maintenance activities to minimize breakdowns and unexpected off-road cases.

Cost Control & Insurance Coordination

· Track repair, maintenance, tire, glass, and service costs against approved budgets.

· Review service records and invoices to ensure accuracy before submission for approval.

· Coordinate with insurance partners for accident repair claims and damage recovery processes.

· Identify abnormal repair costs, repeated damages, or long downtime cases and report them to management.

Driver & Internal Support

· Act as a local support point for drivers regarding vehicle issues, dashboard alerts, charging-related concerns, or repair updates.

· Provide timely updates to internal teams on vehicle maintenance status, repair progress, and off-road cases.

· Support the implementation of repair and maintenance policies, operating procedures, and local compliance requirements.

Requirements

· Bachelor’s degree in Automotive, Engineering, Logistics, Business Administration, or related fields.

· 2–4 years of experience in vehicle repair coordination, maintenance operations, fleet maintenance, automotive service, leasing operations, or related fields.

· Good understanding of vehicle maintenance, repair processes, tires, brakes, glass, body repair, and roadworthiness requirements.

· Experience with electric vehicles or EV maintenance operations is an advantage.

· Ability to coordinate with workshops, repair vendors, insurance providers, drivers, and internal teams.

· Good cost awareness and ability to identify unusual or excessive repair costs.

· Hands-on, proactive, detail-oriented, and able to follow up until issues are resolved.

· Professional fluency in the local language and English.

· Good command of Excel/Google Sheets and fleet or maintenance management tools is preferred.

We appreciate your interest in this opportunity. Given the high volume of applications, we will only be able to contact shortlisted candidates. We value your understanding and patience in this process. Thank you for your interest and cooperation.

title: Senior Driver Handbook Owner
description:
Company description:

"Founded in 1927, the Volvo Group is committed to driving prosperity and shaping the future landscape through sustainable transport, mobility, and infrastructure solutions. By offering trucks, buses, construction equipment, power solutions for marine and industrial applications, financing and services that increase our customers’ uptime and productivity. Our headquarters are in Gothenburg, Sweden. Volvo Group shares are listed on Nasdaq Stockholm."

Job description:





Passionate to build and share information in Volvo Bus service network, thereby keeping buses where they belong, on the road? Do you want to be part of sharing information and solutions to drivers, thereby helping with Uptime? Talk about customer touch point and making the difference!

    

THIS IS US, YOUR NEW COLLEAGUES



We at Global Service and Driver Training department(GST) in Service Market Technology(SMT), Global Bus Technology; deliver world-class knowledge and information management solutions to our service markets. We together own 2 products, ie, Retail competence and Driver handbook. We work in close cooperation with market colleagues, other SMT functions, Product development teams and Volvo Trucks. You will join a team of globally based colleagues in Mexico, Sweden, and Poland.







ROLE DESCRIPTION



The Driver handbook is a key product supporting drivers and in certain instances technicians with information on design and function of the bus; its’ systems and components. The position reports to Manager, Global service Training.  







Main activities and responsibilities:  







Drive, produce and publish product information for driver handbooks: 1. Drive end to end development of driver information products: driver handbook and quick guide 2. Continue developing Digital driver handbook features/next steps including launches 3. Drive and own the Driver handbook E2E process and strategy including Body builder partner management  



This role is much about networking and collaboration with people. An example of this is participating in all phases of our bus development projects and globally coordinate technical information retrieval to plan deliveries together with our suppliers, like system providers, translation agencies and illustrators. Collaborating and building cross functional relationships with IT system solution teams, Operations and other stakeholders is crucial.







Additionally this role will manage planning deliveries ahead of each planning cycle.  



WHO ARE YOU?




    You understand the importance of building and conveying complex technical information in a simple way from a user perspective.  
    To be successful and enjoy this role we think that you like to work in a cross functional environment and build relationships and collaborations  
    We believe it is the right mindset that will make a difference within our organization and our company. If you see yourself taking initiative, building networks, and always learning new things, while thriving in a relaxed social environment, then we believe you have the right attitude to be successful in this position.  







REQUIRED SKILLS and EXPERIENCE  




    Education in Technical Writing, Communication, Engineering, Marketing and/or equivalent experience from automotive industry.  
    Understanding and developing technical information and illustrations  
    Excellent communication and collaboration skills  
    Project management skills  
    Fluent in written and spoken English  
    Knowledge of the Volvo Bus product portfolio and required system applications is an advantage  

      

ARE WE THE PERFECT MATCH?



At Volvo Buses, we are working to take advantage of inherent strength in differences in knowledge, experience, age, gender, nationality, etc. This increases group dynamics, creativity, and new approaches to solutions. So, if you want to be a part of something bigger and have a passion for knowledge management, welcome to our team and Volvo Buses!







CURIOUS, AND HAVE SOME QUESTIONS? Come join us for a cup of coffee or a call! Chandan Patil, Global Service Training, +46 76 553 7869. Due to vacation times we will not take any calls between 30th July and 18th August. 







Last application date: 30th August

    

We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail.







Who we are and what we believe in We are committed to shaping the future landscape of efficient, safe, and sustainable transport solutions. Fulfilling our mission creates countless career opportunities for talents across the group’s leading brands and entities.







Applying to this job offers you the opportunity to join Volvo Group. Every day, you will be working with some of the sharpest and most creative brains in our field to be able to leave our society in better shape for the next generation. ​We are passionate about what we do, and we thrive on teamwork. ​We are almost 100,000 people united around the world by a culture of care, inclusiveness, and empowerment.







At Volvo Buses you join one of the world’s leading providers of sustainable people transport solutions. What we do affects millions of people around the world: passengers, drivers, customers; in fact, entire cities and countries. This job gives you the opportunity to work with the future of people transportation and infrastructure. We have a strong culture of working together to help each other, sharing knowledge and experience. Together, we shape the world we want to live in.

title: Affärsutvecklare
description:
Om jobbet

Vill du arbeta i ett team med stark gemenskap där du har möjlighet att utmana dig själv och följa en affär hela vägen från start till mål? Vill du arbeta i en prestigelös miljö där det är högt i tak, med goda möjligheter att själv påverka din arbetssituation?  

Då är det dig vi söker!

BRS Networks är ett väl etablerat företag på fiber- och IT-marknaden och har i dagsläget ca 75 medarbetare med huvudkontor i Visby. Förutom på Gotland har vi kontor i Kalmar och Mälardalen samt i Tyskland. På IT-avdelningen jobbar vi med att erbjuda helhetslösningar som omfattar allt från datacenter, IT-strategi, IT-infrastruktur, IT-support, IT-säkerhet och IT-utbildning. Vi är en MSP (Managed Service Provider) som tar ett stort ansvar för våra kunders IT-frågor och ser till att de får den bästa möjliga servicen.

Vi har en pågående etablering för att kunna erbjuda systemutveckling, förvaltning och produktutveckling till marknaden och vi söker nu dig som vill vara med och bygga upp den satsningen. Du kommer att arbeta med olika projekt och förvaltningar och i de produktutvecklingar som planeras.

Hos oss på BRS Networks får du vara med och bygga framtidens konsultbolag med engagerade kollegor. Vi värdesätter innovation, samarbete och personlig utveckling.  



Arbetsuppgifter

    Arbeta som affärskonsult med fokus på strategisk systemutveckling med hjälp av AI
    Jobba i pre sale, projekt, och vara med och utveckla nästa generations produkter
    Jobba i tighta team tillsammans med både svenska och internationella kunder

Kvalifikationer

    Eftergymnasial utbildning

title: Lead System & Electronics Engineer – Wearable Airbag ECU
description:
MISSION

Own the system and electronics engineering of a wearable airbag vest ECU, from architecture definition through industrialization and manufacturing release.

The role combines system engineering ownership and electronics design leadership for an existing product platform that will evolve across multiple generations, with increased functionality, connectivity, and performance.

The objective is to deliver safe, robust, manufacturable, and evolvable ECU solutions that meet functional, safety, cost, quality, and planning requirements for a critical safety application.

The role acts as the technical reference, working closely with the Project Manager, hardware and software teams, industrialization, suppliers, and validation teams. In addition, the System lead will be the main technical contact for the Product teams and will work on the integration with them. The team is located in France & Sweden mainly. Travel to France, China, US & other countries is expected regularly (Several times a year)

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

System & Product Architecture

    

Define, maintain, and evolve the ECU system architecture across generations (sensing, processing, power, safety interfaces, connectivity, updates)

    

Perform functional analysis including safety and cybersecurity

    

Define system modularity, interfaces, constraints, and services,

    

Ensure architectural consistency across hardware, embedded software, and connectivity (mobile gateway & cloud interfaces)

    

Own the technical roadmap for future product generations

Electronics Design Leadership

    

Lead and approve key electronics design choices (MCU/SoC, sensors, power architecture, connectivity modules, safety‑critical circuits)

    

Identify technical risks and design hard points and define mitigation actions

    

Validate design results with hardware and software leads

    

Ensure compliance with cost, power consumption, robustness, and environmental constraints specific to wearable products

Development Process, Safety & Compliance

    

Apply suitable systems engineering methods, e.g., following the V‑cycle

    

Ensure alignment with functional safety and quality processes

    

Lead or contribute to risk and safety analyses (DFMEA, PFMEA, hazard analysis)

    

Ensure full traceability from requirements to verification and validation

Requirements & Documentation

    

Define and approve system requirements, product specifications, and interface specifications

    

Ensure consistency of system documentation (item definition, architecture, interfaces)

    

Manage change impact analysis across variants and generations

    

Maintain the design definition file for prototype and series production

Connectivity, FOTA & Lifecycle (ECU Scope)

    

Define ECU‑side architecture for secure connectivity and cloud interaction

    

Own the FOTA strategy (architecture, safety, rollback, validation)

    

Ensure long‑term maintainability and field robustness  (Mobile app and cloud development are out of scope; ECU interfaces are in scope.)

Prototyping & Industrialization

    

Define prototype needs and lead technical validation

    

Support or lead Design for Manufacturing and Test (DFM/DFT)

    

Define system‑level test and production test strategies

    

Ensure readiness for industrialization and manufacturing release

Technical Leadership

    

Coordinate the system and electronics design team

    

Organize technical and architecture reviews

    

Interface with project management, development teams, manufacturing, and suppliers

    

Provide technical support and training when required

PROFILE

Education & Experience

    

Engineering degree (Electronics, Embedded Systems, Mechatronics or equivalent)

    

4–6 years’ experience in embedded real‑time systems

    

Proven background in system architecture, electronics leadership, and safety‑critical products

Skills

    

Strong expertise in embedded electronics and ECU design

    

Solid knowledge of embedded development, low‑power systems, functional safety, connectivity, and FOTA

    

Experience with prototyping and industrialization

Soft Skills

    

Strong technical leadership and communication

    

Autonomous, structured, and solution‑oriented

    

Excellent professional English

Start: ASAP | Duration: Long term  Scope: System & Electronics ownership for current and next‑generation wearable airbag ECUs

title: Principal Engineer - Manufacturing Engineering
description:
Lyten Sweden is seeking a professional and experienced Principal Engineer withing Manufacturing Engineering function. The Principal Engineer is a senior technical leader responsible for defining, scaling, and optimizing manufacturing processes across one or multiple process areas. This role provides strategic direction, technical authority, and mentorship while driving the process development of next-generation battery technology.  The Principal Engineer leads complex, high-impact initiatives from concept through industrialization, including process design, equipment strategy, and factory integration. Acting as a key interface between R&D, operations, quality, and external partners, the role ensures robust, scalable, and cost-efficient manufacturing solutions that support production ramp-up and long-term operational excellence. In addition to hands-on technical contribution, the Principal Engineer establishes engineering standards, drives cross-site alignment, and shapes the technology roadmap for manufacturing processes.



Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership & Strategy

    Define and own process technology strategy and roadmap for assigned manufacturing areas.

    Serve as the subject matter expert (SME) and technical authority across multiple process domains.

    Establish engineering standards, best practices, and design guidelines across the organization.

    Drive alignment between R&D, manufacturing, and supply chain to ensure scalable process development.

Process & Equipment Development

    Lead the development of advanced process and equipment specifications for new and existing manufacturing systems.

    Identify, evaluate, and select strategic equipment suppliers and technology partners.

    Oversee and lead design reviews with equipment suppliers, ensuring technical rigor and scalability.

    Provide guidance and oversight for process development from pilot through high-volume production.

Program & Project Leadership

    Lead large-scale, complex equipment and process development projects with significant business impact.

    Guide cross-functional project teams through all phases: concept, design, FAT, SAT, commissioning, validation, and ramp-up.

    Act as escalation point for critical technical challenges across projects and sites.

Equipment Lifecycle Management

    Provide leadership and governance for installation, commissioning, and validation (IQ/OQ/PQ) of manufacturing equipment.

    Ensure lifecycle strategies are in place for equipment reliability, maintainability, and performance optimization.

Operational Excellence & Continuous Improvement

    Identify and lead high-impact continuous improvement initiatives using Lean, Six Sigma, and other methodologies.

    Drive improvements in yield, throughput, cost, and overall equipment effectiveness (OEE).

    Establish and track process capability metrics and KPIs across production lines and sites.

Troubleshooting & Advanced Problem Solving

    Lead complex root cause analysis (RCA) efforts, including 8D and A3 methodologies, for critical process or equipment failures.

    Provide hands-on expertise for resolution of escalated manufacturing challenges.

    Implement robust corrective and preventive actions to eliminate recurrence.

Data Analysis & Digitalization

    Leverage Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), advanced analytics, and statistical tools to monitor performance and drive optimization.

    Champion data-driven decision-making and digital transformation initiatives within manufacturing engineering.

Governance & Documentation

    Approve and govern process documentation, including SOPs, work instructions, and equipment documentation.

    Ensure compliance with safety, quality, and regulatory standards across all processes.

Coaching & Mentorship

    Mentor and develop process engineers, fostering technical growth and engineering excellence.

    Promote knowledge sharing and capability building across the engineering organization.
    

Requirements

Educational background and previous experience required for the role

Qualifications and Experience

    University advanced degree (Ph.D. preferred) or Master degree Mechanical Design, or related field.

     Minimum of 15 years in cell development or battery manufacturing engineering in senior technical roles  

     Proven track record in advanced cell technologies, including lithium-ion, solid-state, or next-gen battery chemistries.

     Strong team management and mentorship abilities, with experience managing teams

     Ability to set a clear vision and execute strategies that balance innovation with practical, scalable solutions.

     Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with experience presenting to executive teams and stakeholders.

     Able to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving industry, making data-driven decisions and adjusting strategies as needed.

title: Product Manager to Mycronic PCB Assembly Solutions
description:
Mycronic is a global high-tech company that has been driving the electronics industry forward for over 50 years. We continue to grow and support customers across an increasing number of industries, and what we do shapes the technologies that define the society of the future - how we live our lives today and tomorrow. We are now looking for more people who want to join and strengthen our dedicated and driven teams at the forefront of technology. With us, you will work in an open, flexible, and collaborative environment where you collaborate closely with leading experts and take on challenging projects that turn ideas into reality and bring tomorrow’s electronics to life. Welcome to Mycronic!

About the role

Mycronic develops and manufactures advanced solutions for electronics and display production. Within one of our four divisions, the PCB Assembly Solutions division, we provide equipment and software for electronics production, including both standalone machines and complete production solutions. Our customers typically operate in environments with high product mix and small to medium-sized production series.

As Product Manager, you will be part of a team of five, reporting to the Head of Product Management. You will collaborate closely with colleagues across marketing, sales, R&D, operations, supply chain, customer service, applications engineering and finance. The role also includes regular interaction with customers, suppliers and distributors. You will be based in Kista, where Mycronic has both offices and production facilities.

Work tasks

In this broad strategic and operational role, you will have overall responsibility for one of Mycronic’s products within the PCB Assembly Solutions division. You will drive long-term growth, profitability and market position by identifying business opportunities, developing the product strategy and translating customer and market insights into a clear roadmap.

Your responsibilities will include:

    Defining product strategy, business plans, and the long-term evolution of the product portfolio.
    Owning and driving the product roadmap, prioritizing development initiatives based on market trends and customer needs.
    Ensuring long-term profitability and business performance through continuous tracking of product performance, market position, and key business metrics.
    Leading the full product lifecycle – from concept and development through launch, ongoing improvement, and end-of-life management.
    Aligning stakeholders across functions to ensure clear priorities, informed decision-making, and effective execution.
    Driving go-to-market activities and supporting sales and marketing with product positioning, customer insights, and competitive analysis.

We are looking for

We are looking for someone who combines a strong business mindset with technical understanding and takes clear ownership of their area of responsibility. You are strategic, results-oriented and skilled at turning customer needs into value-creating product and business decisions. You collaborate effectively across functions, communicate clearly and build trusted relationships with both internal and external stakeholders.

Furthermore, you have:

    A Bachelor’s (BSc) or Master’s (MSc) degree in Industrial Engineering and Management, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related discipline.
    A track record of working in or closely with product teams, with demonstrated ability to translate customer and market insights into decisions.
    Several years of professional experience in product management.
    Excellent written and spoken English.

It is considered an advantage if you have:

    Knowledge of relevant domains, systems or standards within SMT, PCBA or a related industry.
    Experience from a manufacturing, industrial, or technology company.

Other information

    Start: According to agreement
    Location: Kista + travel
    Extent: Full-time
    Contact details: Recruitment Consultant Johanna Sörell, johanna.sorell@academicwork.se and Vera Mohlin, vera.mohlin@academicwork.se
    This recruitment process is managed by Academic Work. Mycronic requests that all questions regarding the position are directed to Academic Work.

Our recruitment process

    Personality and problem-solving tests
    Phone interview with Academic Work
    In-depth interview with Academic Work
    Interviews with Mycronic
